description:
Hotel Indigo Madrid Gran Vía is located just a few steps from the most famous, modern, vibrant and cosmopolitan street in Madrid, Gran Vía, known for its shops, theatres and impressive architecture. We are much more than a hotel and we make our guests' stays unforgettable experiences.
Enjoy all the hotel facilities, such as the 24-hour gym, restaurant, lobby bar, our infinity pool and terrace.
What do we offer you?
- Fitness Studio Gym – open 24 hours - Wifi – Free Internet for all guests - Own parking - Infinity pool – open seasonally - Rooftop Terrace to see the best sunset in Madrid - The best gastronomy in our spaces: our Restaurant “El Telón” ”, Bar and Terrace.
- Dry cleaning and laundry - We have dry cleaning and laundry service on request.
And all this… in the heart of Madrid!
The famous Puerta del Sol, the heart of Madrid, is a 5-minute walk from the property, where you will find the famous “Kilometer Zero”, the statue of Osod and the Madroño and where you can enjoy many bars, shops and restaurants.
The Royal Palace of Madrid is just a 5-minute walk away and the Plaza Mayor is 600 metres away.
Other nearby places of interest: Parque Del Retiro, Palacio Real, Museo del Prado, Templo de Debod, Mercado de San Miguel, Barrio de Malasaña, El Rastro, among others.
Regarding public transport in the area: Metro: Callao (Lines 3 and 5): A few minutes walk from the hotel. Gran Vía (Lines 1 and 5): Also very close and accessible.
Buses: Several bus lines pass through Gran Vía, including lines 1, 2, 46, 74, 146 and M2.
Suburban trains: Sol Station. Connection with suburban lines C3 and C4, as well as metro lines 1, 2 and 3.

hotel_name: NH Collection Barcelona Gran Hotel Calderon
description:
The elegant NH Collection Barcelona Gran Hotel Calderón has an excellent location just off Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard in central Barcelona. It has fitness centre and a year-round free rooftop pool with spectacular city views.

The air-conditioned rooms at the NH Collection Barcelona Gran Hotel Calderón feature free WiFi, a Nespresso machine and a private bathroom with a rain-effect shower and professional hairdryer.

Room service is also available 24 hours and the Eleven Bar serves cocktails and light snacks.

The breakfast buffet has a variety of high antioxidant dishes and a fresh juice corner. Breakfast can also be requested in your room, and a light early breakfast is available.

Staff in the Guest Relations department can help you throughout your stay and advise you on what to see and do in Barcelona.

The hotel is just one block away from Gaudí’s famous Casa Batlló. You can walk to the city’s Gothic Quarter in about 10 minutes.

Located in the heart of Barcelona, Vincci Gala hotel offers luxurious rooms in a protected 19th-century palace. Free Wi-Fi is available.

The orginal façade, floor and central staircase of this unique hotel have all been preserved, creating a balance of traditional arquitecture and modern design.

The air-conditioned rooms include a private bathroom with hairdryer, free toiletries, and bath or shower. The rooms also come with a free laptop safe, extra large beds, satellite TV with pay-per-view channels, and a minibar.

A restaurant and snack bar are available on-site, and the hotel offers a breakfast buffet. Laundry and car rental services are available at a surcharge, and the property can provide tourist information.

Vincci Gala hotel is located opposite Urquinaona Metro Station, 2 minutes' walk from Plaça Catalunya Square.  There are many bars, restaurants and shops in the surroundings, and you can reach Gaudi's La Sagrada Familia in 15 minutes by metro.

Vincci Marítimo is located 10 minutes’ walk from Barcelona’s Diagonal Mar Shopping Centre and the CCIB Convention Centre. It offers bright, stylish rooms with flat-screen satellite TV and free Wi-Fi throughout.

The air-conditioned rooms at the Hotel Marítimo feature modern décor, with parquet floors and relaxing images of the sea. They come with a pillow menu and the private bathrooms contain a hairdryer. Rooms offer views of the charming Japanese Zen garden or Diagonal Mar Park.

The hotel’s Jardí de Mar Restaurant serves Mediterranean food using fresh ingredients. The hotel's breakfast includes products for celiacs. The Ikebana Lounge Bar offers snacks, tapas and cocktails which can be enjoyed on the terrace.

The hotel’s reception is open 24 hours a day, allowing you greater flexibility during your stay. Laundry and car rental services are also available from the front desk.

The Vincci Marítimo is just 500 metres from Mar Bella Beach. Selva de Mar Metro Station is 2 minutes’ walk from the hotel, connecting you with the city centre in 15 minutes.

Catalonia Barcelona 505 offers spacious rooms with free Wi-Fi and an outdoor swimming pool in Barcelona’s Sant Gervasi area. From El Putxet Train Station, 400 metres away, you can reach the centre in 15 minutes.

The hotel is close to important medical centres, such as the Teknon Clinic, Sant Jordi Clinic, Dexeus and Barraquer. It is also next to the Blue Tram, which takes you to the cable car for Tibidabo.

Air-conditioned rooms have a satellite TV, a safe and minibar. There is a work desk, and the private bathroom comes with a hairdryer and amenities.

The restaurant C50&5 offers international cuisine. There is a bar and room service is available.

You can hire a car from the 24-hour front desk. On-site parking is offered for an additional charge, and the hotel has easy access to the B20 Motorway.

Located on Passeig Picasso, Miiro Borneta is set opposite Ciutadella Park. This boutique hotel features a rooftop swimming pool, a restaurant, a comfortable lounge area and a bar with outdoor seating, and stylish rooms with free Wi-Fi.

Each modern, air-conditioned room at Miiro Borneta has contemporary décor. There is flat screen HDTV, tea and coffee-making facilities.

Guests can enjoy a breakfast in the Volta Restaurant. Mediterranean cuisine are served for lunch and dinner. There is also Volta Bar with outdoor seating under the arches – the perfect spot for cocktails, natural wines and bar plates, the Gallery – a comfortable lounge area to hang out during the day, a library featuring books on the local neighbourhood and a private dining room..

The hotel is set in the stylish El Born district and is a 5-minute walk from the Picasso Museum. Las Ramblas and the Gothic Quarter are within 1 km of the Miiro Borneta.

Barceloneta and Jaume I Metro Stations can be reached in 10 minutes by foot. Regular buses to La Barceloneta’s beaches stop nearby.

Novotel Barcelona City is situated in the avant-garde area of the city just 15 minutes from central Barcelona, next to the Agbar Tower, designed by Jean Nouvel.

Moreover, the unique Sagrada Familia and Bogatell Beach are just a few minutes away, walking from the hotel.

The air-conditioned rooms at Novotel Barcelona City have simple, modern décor. Up to 2 children under 16 stay for free when sharing with parents. The rooms include free Wi fi and flat screen satellite TV.

The hotel’s restaurant offers typical Mediterranean food and the typical paella.

On the rooftop there is an outdoor swimming pool and a gourmet bar where guests can enjoy tapas, wines and cocktails enjoying panoramic city views.

This hotel offers a free gym and a roof terrace with a seasonal outdoor pool and panoramic views of Barcelona.

Tram and bus services to the city center stop outside the hotel. Glòries Metro Station is just 300 metres away.

The reception staff will be more than happy to provide you with all the tips and tricks to make your stay in Barcelona unforgettable! Don't hesitate to stop by for recommendations on must-see attractions, restaurants, and so much more.

Business travellers particularly like the location.

The Atiram Oriente is located on Las Ramblas, between the Liceu Theatre and the Columbus Monument. Set in a 19th-century building, this hotel features a restaurant, terrace and free Wi-Fi.

All rooms have satellite TV and an en suite bathroom with a hairdryer. Each has simple, contemporary décor with heating and air conditioning.

The hotel’s pretty restaurant serves buffet cuisine and a daily continental breakfast. There is a 24-hour reception and a tour desk. The Atiram Oriente Barcelona also has a café on the Ramblas, close to many shops and restaurants.

The famous Boquería Market and Gothic Quarter are just a few minutes’ walk from the Hotel Atiram Oriente. Barcelona’s Port Vell is less than 500 metres away and Liceu Metro Station is 1 minute walk from the hotel.

hotel_name: Grand Hotel Central, Small Luxury Hotels
description:
Grand Central Hotel Barcelona is a design hotel offering fantastic views of the Gothic Quarter and Barcelona Cathedral from its rooftop infinity pool. It has stylish rooms and free high-speed WiFi.

The elegantly refurbished hotel is housed in an early 20th-century building and it is a clear example of the Catalan Noucentisme.

The air-conditioned rooms at the Grand Hotel Barcelona have a modern design. They are equipped with a 4K high-definition TV´s with Chromecast . Each one has a bathroom with a large, rain-effect shower and luxury toiletries.

The restaurant offers an authentic Spanish-style dining experience with small "platillos" to be shared, as well as a selection of over 150 local and national wines. An excellent culinary proposal that will make you feel like a local. La Terraza del Central, in the rooftop, is the perfect place to enjoy a dinner, a cocktail or both overlooking the city lights of Barcelona.

The hotel has a fitness centre and massage services are also offered. Staff at the 24-hour reception can provide information about what to see and do in Barcelona, and you can also hire a car or a bicycle.

The Born district, full of stylish shops and restaurants, is just 3 minutes’ walk from the Grand Central Hotel.

Attractively located in Barcelona, Hotel Casa Sagnier features air-conditioned rooms, a fitness centre, free WiFi and a terrace. Featuring a restaurant, the property also has a bar, as well as a sauna. The accommodation provides room service, a concierge service and luggage storage for guests.

At the hotel, rooms include a desk. The rooms include a private bathroom with free toiletries, while some rooms have a balcony and others also feature city views. All rooms at Hotel Casa Sagnier are fitted with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels and a safety deposit box.

The daily breakfast offers buffet, à la carte or continental options.

Speaking Catalan, German, English and Spanish at the 24-hour front desk, staff are always on hand to help.

Popular points of interest near the accommodation include Passeig de Gracia, La Pedrera and Casa Batllo. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 13 km from the property, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

Centrally located on Barcelona’s famous Las Ramblas Boulevard, this aparthotel offers 24-hour reception and is surrounded by many restaurants, bars and shops. Free WiFi is available throughout the property.

All air-conditioned studios and apartments at Citadines Ramblas Barcelona feature a kitchen with a microwave, fridge and dishwasher. Bathrooms are equipped with hairdryers and all rooms have a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. All Classic Rooms are equipped with fridge and kettle.


Linen and towels are provided. The apartment is cleaned and linen and towels are changed for free once a week. An additional housecleaning service is available upon request and is charged according to your needs.

Bicycle and car rental can be arranged for guests at Citadines. Luggage storage is also available and the aparthotel operates a ticket service for attractions in Barcelona.

Plaza Catalunya Metro Station is just 100 metres away, and airport buses leave from the square. The impressive Boqueria Market is 2 minutes’ walk from Citadines Ramblas.

Pere IV is situated in the Poble Nou District, 10 minutes’ walk from the lively Port Olimpic area and Barcelona's beaches. This hotel features a free spa, free Wi-Fi, a seasonal roof top terrace and 24-hour reception.

Each of the spacious rooms comes with a minibar, and a flat-screen TV with satellite channels.

The à la carte Garum Restaurant offers Mediterranean cuisine. The hotel serves a daily, buffet breakfast.

Guests enjoy free access to the Pere IV's spa, which includes a Finnish sauna, a hammam, indoor pool and sensation showers.

The Pere IV is a short walk from the beach and the new marina. Nearby Bogatell Metro Station offers easy access to the beach and the city centre, which can both be reached within 15 minutes.

Situated on Plaza Catalunya in the centre of Barcelona, the Hotel Olivia Plaza offers free Wi-Fi and a terrace bar with views of Santa Ana Church. Stylish rooms include a flat-screen TV.

This design hotel serves a buffet breakfast and guests can also order breakfast to the room. The modern Nineteen restaurant offers Mediterranean cuisine.

The chic rooms at the Olivia Hotel Barcelona include a free safe and views over the square. They are also equipped with a sofa or armchair and a breakfast table.

Guests at Olivia Plaza Hotel have free access to Holmes Place Urquinaona gym, located 500 metres from the hotel. Guests can make free use of the pool area and fitness room there.

The Olivia Plaza Barcelona is just 100 metres from the famous Ramblas with its many restaurants and street performers. Catalunya Metro Station is 2 minutes’ walk from the hotel and the Gothic Quarter is less than 10 minutes away.

Set beside Barcelona's Francesc Macià Square, Vincci Mae features a terrace with a plunge pool and fantastic views of Diagonal Avenue and Tibidabo Mountain.

Vincci Mae boasts an on-site restaurant and bar, it also has a 24-hour front desk and offers free WiFi throughout the property.  An assorted buffet breakfast is offered everyday.

Stylish rooms feature a simple and bright décor, air-conditioning, a flat-screen TV, kettle, and minibar. The fancy private bathroom includes a shower, free toiletries ,and a hairdryer.

Casa Batlló is 1.6 km from Vincci Mae, while La Pedrera is 1.3 km away. You can reach Plaza Catalunya in 20 minutes in public transport.

NH Collection Barcelona Pódium offers stylish, modern accommodation in a quiet area of central Barcelona. It has free WiFi, a sauna, gym and roof terrace with swimming pool and city views.

Bedrooms at the hotel are spacious and air conditioned. They all have a choice of pillows, a minibar and satellite TV. Each room comes with a Barcelona city guidebook.

NH Collection Barcelona Pódium combines a 19th-Century façade with modern interior design. It is surrounded by other Modernist buildings in Barcelona’s Eixample district.

The hotel is set 800 metres from Plaça Catalunya and the Ramblas, near the city’s Gothic Quarter. Ciutadella Park and the Olympic Port are also within walking distance.

The NH Collection Podium Hotel has good access to all parts of the city by public transport. Arc de Triomf Metro Station is just 200 metres from the hotel.

NH Collection Barcelona Pódium's restaurant serves Mediterranean cuisine and there is also a lounge bar. A healthy breakfast is available in the mornings. The restaurant is closed during summer months.

Housed in a traditional 19th-century building, this hotel is located between Plaza de Catalunya and Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter. It offers free Wi-Fi and an outdoor pool surrounded by painted murals.

The Catalonia Portal de l'Angel maintains much of its original design. It features comfortable rooms with air conditioning, satellite TV and coffee and tea facilities. The private bathrooms come with a hairdryer.

A buffet breakfast is served daily from 07:30 to 11:00 at Catalonia Portal de l'Angel.

The famous Las Ramblas is less than 200 metres away, while Barcelona Cathedral is 100 metres from the hotel. The Portal de l'Angel is just a 5-minute walk from Catalunya Metro and Railway Station.

Featuring a rooftop swimming pool and hot tub with views of Barcelona, Sunotel Central is set in the centre of Barcelona, just 10 minutes' walk from Plaza Catalunya.

Modern rooms at Sunotel Central include free high-speed WiFi, satellite TV and a private bathroom with a hairdryer and amenities.

Universitat Metro Station is just 200 metres from the hotel. The Ramblas, famous for its street performers, can be reached in 10 minutes by foot.

In the morning guests can enjoy a varied, fresh and healthy full buffet breakfast.

The hotel’s 24-hour reception offers a ticket booking service and luggage storage. There are computers in the lobby which guests can use for free. Meeting rooms are also available.

Set just off Barcelona’s famous Las Ramblas, 3 minutes’ walk from central Plaza Catalunya, Catalonia Ramblas 4* Sup  features a seasonal outdoor pool with a south-facing terrace, a poolside snack bar and a chill-out area.

Housed in a modernist building, all bright and spacious rooms come with a flat-screen satellite smart TV equipped with Chromecast App, free WiFi and tea and coffee facilities. Some have a private terrace with a private pool. Room service is available.

The spa at Catalonia Ramblas 4* Sup features a relaxation area. It includes a sauna, a steam bath and a hot tub. Massage and beauty treatments are also available.

The hotel’s restaurant, Pelai Restaurant, offers Catalan market cuisine. Dishes cooked on a coal stove are available at the Pelai terrace, a rooftop terrace with a chill-out area with panoramic city views. A buffet breakfast is offered every morning and, on weekends, it is available until 11:00.

In the summer months, the terrace is open until 00:00 and has a summer menu, as well as cocktails and milkshakes.

Featuring free WiFi, Blue Barcelona is located in the Gracia district of Barcelona. Set next to Gracia FGC Station, this bed and breakfast offers a shared lounge and tour desk.

Each air-conditioned room at the property has a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, desk, and hardwood floors. Some rooms have a private bathroom with a bath or shower and free toiletries, and others have access to shared bathroom facilities.

You can find several restaurants, bars, and shops within a 5-minute walk of Blue Barcelona. There are vending machines available.

Fontana Metro Station is 300 metres from the property, Plaza Catalunya and Las Ramblas Boulevard are 2 metro stops away, and Gaudi’s Sagrada Familia is 2.3 km from the property.

Hotel El Palace Barcelona is located in Eixample District, close to the Ramblas, the main shopping area and Barcelona’s main tourist attractions. It offers a Mayan-style luxury spa. A limousine service with a chauffeur is available on request.

Opened in 1919, this hotel features a neo-classical façade and stylish air-conditioned rooms with classic decor. Each room is spacious and comes with satellite TV, desk, minibar and a private bathroom with hairdryer, bathrobe and slippers.

There are 2 restaurants: L'Éclair, located at the hall, and the Winter Garden Restaurant, set at the Roof Terrace; guests can also enjoy a cocktail at the Bluesman Cocktail Bar.

Hotel El Palace Barcelona has a Mayan-style spa with a Temazcal Sauna. Other facilities at this hotel include both fitness and business center and an outdoor pool.

Third person sharing in room is available for Superior room, Junior Suite and Superior Suite.

Staff at Hotel El Palace Barcelona can provide information about the area. Passeig de Gràcia Metro and Railway Station as well as Urquinaona Metro station are less than 5 minutes’ walk of the hotel.

Gaudí’s Casa Batlló and La Pedrera are approximately 15 minutes’ walk away.

Catalonia Diagonal Centro is set in the heart of Barcelona’s Eixample district, 300 metres from Diagonal Metro Station. It features a seasonal outdoor pool and free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel.

At the Catalonia Diagonal Centro, you can enjoy modern, comfortable accommodation next to some of Barcelona’s most popular sights. All hotel rooms have smart TVs, which are equipped with Chromecast app

Only 300 metres away on Passeig de Gràcia is La Pedrera, one of Gaudi’s famous creations. Take a stroll past the Modernista buildings to reach Plaça Catalunya and the lively Ramblas area.

Back at the hotel, relax in your stylish bedroom with contemporary wooden furniture and marble en suite bathroom. Watch satellite television or take advantage of the free wireless internet connection.

A short stroll from the hotel takes you to trendy Gràcia, with its bohemian shops and leafy squares, and a huge selection of bars and restaurants. Nearby metro and bus lines make it easy to see the whole of this cosmopolitan city.

Catalonia Albeniz offers spacious, air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi and satellite TV. It is situated 150 metres from Clot Train Station, and a 15-minute walk from Gaudí’s Sagrada Familia Church.

The property has a gym and an outdoor pool. You can also use the luggage storage facility on site at the Albeniz.

The varied buffet breakfast at the Catalonia Albeniz includes typical local dishes, such as potato omelette and bread with tomato.

hotel_name: Hotel Indigo Madrid - Princesa, an IHG Hotel
description:
Recently renovated, up-to-date, downtown hotel, well positioned and easily accessed in the midst of the fashionable Moncloa-Argüelles residential and business district of Madrid.

The Hotel Indigo Madrid - Princesa is located just across the street from the department store El Corte Inglés of Princesa and a short walking distance from the Plaza de España, the Royal Palace and the University Campus.

Ideally situated in the centre of Madrid, DoubleTree by Hilton Madrid-Prado features air-conditioned rooms, a fitness centre, free WiFi and a restaurant. This 4-star hotel offers room service and a 24-hour front desk. Guests can have a drink at the bar.

All rooms will provide guests with a minibar.

The hotel offers a buffet or continental breakfast.

Popular points of interest near DoubleTree by Hilton Madrid-Prado include El Retiro Park, Reina Sofia Museum and Atocha Train Station. Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport is 13 km from the property.

This comfortable guest house is located in the heart Madrid, 20 metres from Gran Vía. It offers bright and airy rooms with balconies and free Wi-Fi, 4 minutes’ walk from Puerta del Sol.

Hostal Aliste’s pleasant and cosy rooms all come with a TV, minibar and a safe, while the private bathrooms have a hairdryer and free toiletries. Some rooms are air-conditioned and others have a fan.

A wide range of bars, restaurants and shops are a 5-minute walk away. Guests can use the house computer for free and tourist information is available.

Madrid’s main sites are all easily accessible by foot. Madrid’s Art Triangle is within 20 minutes’ walk away, while Madrid Cathedral and the Royal Palace are 1 km away.

Hostal Aliste is a 30-second walk from Gran Vía Metro station, connecting with Barajas Airport in 40 minutes.  Atocha AVE Train Station is 2 km away.

Situated in Madrid, less than 1 km from Atocha Train Station and a 7-minute walk from Reina Sofia Museum, Reina Sofía Museum House provides accommodation with amenities such as free WiFi and a flat-screen TV. The property has inner courtyard views and is 2.6 km from El Retiro Park and 1.4 km from Mercado San Miguel. The property is 1.3 km from Puerta de Toledo, and within 1.2 km of the city centre.

The air-conditioned apartment consists of 2 bedrooms, a living room, a fully equipped kitchen with a dishwasher and a coffee machine, and 1 bathroom with a shower and a hair dryer. Towels and bed linen are available in the apartment. The accommodation is non-smoking.

Popular points of interest near the apartment include Plaza Mayor, Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum and Gran Via Metro Station. The nearest airport is Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport, 15 km from Reina Sofía Museum House.

Boasting city views, ATyCO Madrid features accommodation with balcony, around 3.5 km from Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum. Among the facilities at this property are a 24-hour front desk and a lift, along with free WiFi throughout the property. The apartment has family rooms and facilities for disabled guests.

All units at the apartment complex come with air conditioning, a seating area, a flat-screen TV with streaming services, a kitchen, a dining area and a private bathroom with a hair dryer, a walk-in shower and free toiletries. A microwave, a toaster and fridge are also available, as well as a coffee machine and a kettle. At the apartment complex, each unit is fitted with bed linen and towels.

Sightseeing tours are available within a reachable distance of the property. If you would like to discover the area, pub crawls is possible in the surroundings.

Santiago Bernabéu Stadium is 3.5 km from the apartment, while El Retiro Park is 3.6 km from the property. Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport is 9 km away.

Set in Madrid, 500 metres from Atocha Train Station and 700 metres from Reina Sofia Museum, Smartr Atocha Reina Sofia offers free WiFi and air conditioning. It is located 1.8 km from Puerta de Toledo and offers a lift. The apartment has family rooms.

Each unit has a fully equipped kitchen with a dishwasher, a seating area, a TV, a washing machine, and a private bathroom with shower and a hair dryer. An oven, a microwave and fridge are also offered, as well as a coffee machine. At the apartment complex, units are fitted with bed linen and towels.

El Retiro Park is 1.8 km from the apartment, while Plaza Mayor is 2.5 km from the property. Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport is 15 km away.

URBANSEA Atocha 113 is a modern and minimalist hotel is located beside the lovely Retiro Park, less than 10 minutes’ walk from Atocha Station. It features a rooftop sun terrace and free Wi-Fi throughout.

Air-conditioned rooms at URBANSEA Atocha 113 feature stylish décor in white with subtle hints of colour and parquet floors. They come with a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with shower and hairdryer.

This design hotel offers a lounge area with free coffee and mineral water. Lugage storage and newspapers can be provided at the 24-hour front desk.

Guests can find many tapas bars, restaurants and shops nearby the hotel. Positioned in the Art Triangle, the URBANSEA Atocha 113 is within 10 minutes’ walk of the Reina Sofía, Prado and Thyssen-Bornemisza museums. The Botanical Gardens are 200 metres away.

Located next to Madrid’s Puerta del Sol, this hotel offers rooms with free WiFi.

The modern, soundproofed rooms at the Petit Palace Puerta del Sol are air-conditioned and feature parquet floors. There is a minibar and safe, and the private bathroom comes with a hairdryer.

The hotel restaurant serves a buffet breakfast. Due to its central location, the Petit Palace is surrounded by restaurants and bars.

Staff at the Petit Palace’s 24-hour reception can provide information about what to do in Madrid, and you can hire a bicycle for free. Car hire is available, and guest have discount for a car park nearby.

Puerta del Sol is just 10 minutes’ walk from the Royal Palace and the Plaza Mayor. It is also a 10-minute walk to the Prado, Thyssen and Reina Sofía Museums.

In the Chamberi district of Madrid, close to Gran Via, Live It Madrid Chamberi has a terrace and a washing machine. It is situated 2.2 km from Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum and features a lift. Free WiFi is available throughout the property and Gran Via Metro Station is 1.7 km away.

At the guest house, all units are equipped with a desk. Some units also have a well-fitted kitchen equipped with a fridge. At the guest house, units include bed linen and towels.

Temple of Debod is 2.5 km from the guest house, while Plaza de España Metro Station is 1.8 km from the property. The nearest airport is Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport, 17 km from Live It Madrid Chamberi.

BG5 Estudio Arguelles Moncloa is located in the Chamberi district of Madrid, less than 1 km from Plaza de España Metro Station, a 19-minute walk from Royal Palace of Madrid and 1.7 km from Gran Via. The property is situated 1.8 km from Gran Via Metro Station, 2.8 km from Mercado San Miguel and 3 km from Plaza Mayor. Free WiFi is available throughout the property and Temple of Debod is 1 km away.

The air-conditioned apartment consists of 1 bedroom, a fully equipped kitchenette and 1 bathroom. A flat-screen TV is provided. The accommodation is non-smoking.

Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum is 3.5 km from the apartment, while Puerta del Sol is 2 km away. Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport is 18 km from the property.

Located a 5-minute drive from Madrid Exhibition Centre IFEMA and a 8-minute drive from Barajas Airport, Hotel Best Osuna is set in attractive gardens, and features a seasonal outdoor swimming pool.

The rooms at the Hotel Osuna are spacious and have attractive, traditional-style décor. Each room has a minibar and satellite TV.

The hotel’s H20 Restaurant serves a range of Mediterranean cuisine and offers views of the seasonal pool. Guests can also enjoy a drink in the bar.

You can make use of the hotel’s 24-hour reception and luggage storage facilities.

Hotel Best Osuna is less than 500 metres from Canillejas Metro Station, which connects guests to Madrid in 25 minutes. The nearby M-40 Motorway also offers easy access to the city centre. It is located at 12 minutes drive from the Wanda Metropolitano Stadium.

The elegant Rosewood Villa Magna offers exclusive rooms and suites in Madrid’s fashionable Salamanca area. The hotel boasts a spa, marble bathrooms and views onto Serrano Street or Castellana Avenue.

The large, luxurious rooms in Villa Magna Hotel have antique-style furniture and modern finishes. All rooms have laptop safes with in-built chargers. Some rooms have rain showers.

Sense, A Rosewood Spa at the hotel offers a range of treatments, including massage, spa area and a fitness centre offering cutting-edge cardio equipment.

Rosewood Villa Magna offers a compelling destination for culinary excellence, including Las Brasas de Castellana where the protagonist is the grill, AMÓS Restaurant by Chef Jesús Sánchez the essence of Cantabria, TARDE.O classic cocktails with an urban late-night vibe, and the magnifique Flor y Nata patisserie with an all-day café with gourmet option for an easy meal.

The hotel is located close to Madrid's Golden Mile shopping district and is within 10 minutes' walk of Santiago Bernabéu Stadium.

room00 Chueca Hostel is set between Madrid’s fashionable Chueca and Malasaña neighbourhoods. Located 100 metres from Chueca Metro Station, this hostel features free Wi-Fi.

Gran Via, famous for shopping and its theatres, is 400 metres from the hostel. Chueca and Tribunal metro stations are within a 5-minute walk of the hostel.

Set in a central area of Madrid, 300 metres from Gran Via and 400 metres from Gran Via Metro Station, Hostal Tudescos offers air-conditioned accommodation with a balcony and free WiFi. The 1-star guest house is 1.3 km from Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum. Mercado San Miguel is less than 1 km from the guest house and Plaza Mayor is a 10-minute walk away.

At the guest house, each unit comes with a desk. The units are equipped with heating facilities.

Sightseeing tours are available in the neighbourhood.

Popular points of interest near the guest house include Plaza de España Metro Station, Temple of Debod and Royal Palace of Madrid. Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport is 13 km away.

Ibis Styles Madrid Centro Maravillas is set in Madrid’s popular Malasaña district, 250 metres from Plaza del 2 de Mayo and a 5-minute drive from the financial district of Colón. Bilbao Metro Station is a 2-minute walk.

All rooms at Ibis Styles Madrid Centro Maravillas are outward-facing and feature modern, functional decor. They have air conditioning, free high speed WiFi, wooden floors and a flat-screen satellite TV with international channels. Private bathrooms include a shower and hairdryer.

Ibis Styles Madrid Centro Maravillas bar and reception are open 24 hours a day. You can enjoy a range of hot and cold dishes at the snack bar.

Ibis Styles Madrid Centro Maravillas is surrounded by numerous restaurants and tapas bars. Paseo del Prado and the Thyssen Bornemisza Museum can be reached in 20 minutes on foot, while Puerta del Sol is 1.5 km away. Madrid Barajas-Adolfo Suárez Airport is 20 minutes by car.

CH Velarde offers budget accommodation near the popular Chueca and Malasaña areas of central Madrid. Each simple room includes heating, a fan, TV and free Wi-Fi internet access.

Le Petit Palü- Velarde, is located 100 meters from the Tribunal metro station and a 20-minute walk from Puerta del Sol. There is easy access to the Prado and Reina Sofía museums by metro or bus.

The guest house is near the cafés and tapas bars of Malasaña, and within 10 minutes' walk of the lively nightlife of Chueca.

Located 15 minutes’ drive from Madrid and with easy access to the M30 and M40 motorways, Exe Madrid Norte offers free Wi-Fi. Set in gardens, it features a seasonal outdoor swimming pool.

Queen-size beds are on offer in each of the stylish rooms at the Exe Madrid Norte. All rooms have tea and coffee-making facilities and a 26” LCD TV.

The property's Gourmet Bar serves local and international, simple and authentic cuisine in a relaxed atmosphere. A variety of cocktails are also served.

The IFEMA Exhibition Centre is a 10-minute drive from the hotel and Madrid Barajas Airport is less than 5 km away. The number 173, 174 and 176 buses stop close to the Exe Madrid Norte.

This luxury hotel is located in the heart of Madrid, within the Art Triangle. The Parliament is across the road, and the Royal Palace and Opera House within walking distance.

The Westin Palace offers elegant facilities only 300 metres from the Prado, Thyssen and Reina Sofia Museums.

The hotel is famous for its beautiful stained-glass dome. Here a fantastic buffet breakfast with music is served.

Rooms at the Palace are elegant and modern. They have the award-winning Westin Heavenly Bed and Heavenly Bath. There is also antique furniture and an internet television.

Cocktails, coffees and aperitifs are offered in the Palace Bar, under the dome. Offering live music, the bar was made famous by Ernest Hemingway in his novel The Sun Also Rises.

description:

description:

Catalonia Eixample 1864 boasts a rooftop swimming pool, sundeck and bar; as well as a gym.

The Catalonia Eixample 1864 is ideally located just a 5-minute walk from Passeig de Gracia Station. Plaza Catalunya Square is a 10-minute walk away.

The hotel offers private parking on-site for an extra cost and an electric vehicle charging station.

Hotel Oasis is located just 250 metres from França Railway Station and 100 metres from Barcelona’s Born district. The modern, air-conditioned rooms have satellite TV and private bathrooms with hairdryer.

The hotel features a seasonal terrace with a seasonal outdoor pool. The hotel's Oasis café-bar offers a range of hot drinks and cocktails throughout the day.

The beach and bars of Barceloneta are just 200 metres away, while Santa Maria del Mar Church is 4 minutes’ walk away. Oasis is 50 metres from Barceloneta Metro Station, and 300 metres from Ciutadella Park.

Please be aware that the type of bed is always subject to availability.

Barcelona Universal offers free Wi-Fi, a gym and a rooftop pool with city ciews. Situated next to next to Parallel Metro Station, the hotel is just 600 metres from Las Ramblas.

The spacious, functional rooms at the Barcelona Universal Hotel feature wooden floors and air conditioning. Bathrooms include toiletries and heated towel rails.

The Barcelona Universal’s Medea serves a hot and cold buffet breakfast, including plenty of healthy options.

The hotel is situated a 20-minute walk from the Magic Fountain and MNAC Art Museum, in Montjuïc. Plaça Catalunya is just 3 Metro stops away, and the lively bars of the Raval district are just 500 metres away.

Located on Gran Via, in central Barcelona, the stylish Hotel Soho features a rooftop seasonal pool and sun terrace with panoramic views. It is a 10-minute walk from Plaza Catalunya and Passeig de Gracia Boulevard.

The chic, air-conditioned rooms at the Soho are soundproof and offer flat-screen satellite TV and free Wi-Fi. They also have an ambient lighting system and include modern bathrooms with hairdryers.

Guests can enjoy a rich breakfast on the spacious terrace, weather permitting. The front desk is available 24-hours a day and offers a ticket service.

The Soho is a 5-minute walk from the airport bus stop in Plaza Universitat, and Urgell Metro Station is just 130 metres away.

Conveniently set in the centre of Barcelona, Hotel Rec Barcelona - Adults Only provides air-conditioned rooms, a seasonal outdoor swimming pool, free WiFi and a shared lounge. 2 km from Somorrostro Beach and 2 km from Barceloneta Beach, the property offers a terrace and a bar. Private parking is available on site.

All units are equipped with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a kettle, a shower, free toiletries and a desk. Each room includes a private bathroom with a hairdryer, while selected rooms have a balcony and others also offer city views. Guest rooms include a safety deposit box.

Breakfast is available daily, and includes buffet, continental and American options.

Speaking Catalan, German, English and Spanish, staff are always on hand to help at the reception.

Popular points of interest near the hotel include Passeig de Gracia, Palau de la Musica Catalana and Tivoli Theatre. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 13 km away.

Located in the quiet San Gervasi district of Barcelona, this elegant hotel offers modern rooms with free internet connection. The Silken is just 8 minutes by train from Plaza Catalunya.

The restaurant at Silken San Gervasi offers traditional cuisine with modern influences. A breakfast buffet is served in the cafeteria, and drinks and snacks are also available throughout the day.

Functional rooms include a free safe and central heating and air conditioning. The marble bathroom is complete with a hairdryer.

Silken St. Gervasi is a 15-minute walk from Park Guell, with impressive structures, mosaics and architecture by Antoni Gaudí. El Putxet Station can be found 50 metres from the hotel with direct access to the city centre.

Located 400 metres from Sants Station in Barcelona, NH Sants Barcelona offers modern, air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi, flat-screen TV and private bathroom.

The hotel has a restaurant, serving fresh Mediterranean cuisine. There is also a relaxing café-bar. It also offers a healthy breakfast. The restaurant is closed during summer months.

The NH Sants Barcelona is set in a quiet area of Barcelona's Les Corts Financial District, but Barcelona city centre is within 15 minutes by Metro. Guests can reach FC Barcelona Football Stadium from Sants Metro Station, which is 300 metres away.

Exe Ramblas Boquería is situated right on Barcelona’s famous Las Ramblas, next to La Boquería Market. The stylish, air-conditioned rooms offer free WiFi, flat-screen satellite TV and a private balcony.

Exe Ramblas Boquería features elegant modern décor, with hardwood floors and designer furniture. The soundproofed rooms have views of Las Ramblas or the colourful Boqueria Market.

A varied buffet breakfast is served in the Exe Ramblas Boquería’s bright dining room. The Boquería is an ideal place to sample typical tapas and fresh fruit, while numerous restaurants and bars can be found nearby.

Barcelona Cathedral and Plaça Catalunya are both within 400 metres of the hotel. Liceu Metro Station is just 100 metres away.

Room Mate Pau is set 50 metres from the emblematic Plaza Catalunya. It offers a stylish décor and a terrace and bright, contemporary rooms with free Wi-Fi.

Rooms at Room Mate Pau feature chic decor and air conditioning. All include a plasma TV with USB port for laptop connection, a minibar, safe and a modern private bathroom.

A buffet breakfast is served daily, which you can enjoy at the property's shared terrace. Events can be catered for and various bars, restaurants and shops are within 2 minutes’ walk.

Other facilities include meeting and conference rooms.

Room Mate Pau is 2 minutes’ walk from Las Ramblas and Passeig de Gracia, with its exclusive shops and Gaudí monuments. Urquinaona Metro station is 150 metres away, 2 stops from Barceloneta and its beach.

The hotel can help book tickets and activities and is 250 metres from Catalunya Metro and FGC Train Station.

Boasting a terrace, The Moods Oasis is situated in Barcelona in the Catalonia region, 600 metres from Passeig de Gracia and 1.1 km from La Pedrera. Featuring a fitness centre, the 3-star hotel has air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi, each with a private bathroom. The accommodation features room service, a concierge service and organising tours for guests.

At the hotel, the rooms are fitted with a wardrobe. All rooms in The Moods Oasis are fitted with a flat-screen TV and a hairdryer.

Buffet and continental breakfast options are available at the accommodation.

Speaking Catalan, English, Spanish and French, staff will be happy to provide guests with practical advice on the area at the reception.

Casa Batllo is 1.5 km from The Moods Oasis, while Passeig de Gracia Metro Station is 1.8 km from the property. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 13 km away.

Situated in Barcelona, 1.4 km from Sagrada Familia, Golden Hotel Barcelona provides a rooftop terrace with outdoor swimming pool, jacuzzi and bar. 1.5 km from Port Olympic, the property is also 1.7 km from Sagarda Familia and 1.9 km away from Picasso Museum. There is a gym, a restaurant and a shared lounge.
 All guests staying at the Golden Hotel Barcelona get 1 free entry for person and stay to the spa at Hotel & Spa Villa Olimpic@ Suites complex (subject to availability and with prior reservation), located 450 meters away.
A buffet breakfast is available each morning at the property.
Speaking Spanish, Catalan, German and English at the reception, staff are ready to help around the clock.
Barcelona El Prat Airport is 15 km from the property.

Boasting 1950s décor, this modern hotel offers air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi and flat-screen satellite TV. Barcelona’s Plaza Espanya is 8 minutes’ walk away.

The rooms at the Chic & Basic Velvet have parquet floors and smart décor. Each one has a private bathroom with a hairdryer and free toiletries.

The hotel serves a daily buffet breakfast in the dining room; and guests can enjoy a drink at the honesty bar which has direct access to terrace.

There is a variety of restaurants within 10 minutes’ walk.

Chic & Basic Velvet is just 10 minutes’ walk from the Fira Convention Centre and the airport bus stop. Montjüic, with the Joan Miró Museum and Magic Fountain, is also a 10-minute walk away

This design hotel is right next to Plaza Catalunya in the centre of Barcelona. It has a rooftop garden terrace and offers free high-speed WiFi.

Set in a 19th-Century building, the hotel features modern, elegant décor. Its rooms include free tea and coffee, air conditioning, heating, and flat-screen satellite TV. The private bathrooms include luxury cosmetics. Some rooms have a private balcony.

A varied buffet breakfast with zero-kilometre and homemade products is served. Gluten-free breakfasts can be requested.

Hotel Pulitzer Barcelona has a gastronomic restaurant with a terrace, lobby bar and library. Around 100 live music sessions take place on the terrace throughout the year.

The 24-hour reception offers services such as bike and scooter rental, massages and personal training or yoga sessions.

The Hotel Pulitzer Barcelona has a Biosphere Responsible Tourism certificate.

This ultra-modern hotel is located right on central Barcelona’s Ramblas, just 300 metres from the seafront promenade. It offers stylish, air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi and flat-screen satellite TV.

The rooms at the Ikonik Ramblas feature parquet floors and chic décor. Each one comes with a minibar and a private bathroom with a hairdryer.

Staff at the 24-hour reception can provide information about what Barcelona has to offer. They can also help booking tickets for guided tours, live shows and other events.

Many famous sites are within easy walking distance. The Liceu Theatre is 400 metres away, while Plaza Real is a 3-minute walk away. Barcelona Cathedral is less 800 metres away.

You can walk to Barcelona’s famous Boquería Market in 7 minutes from the hotel. Airport buses leave from Plaza Catalunya, located 15 minutes’ walk away.

Set on Paral-lel Avenue, this modern design hotel is just a 5-minute walk from the famous Las Ramblas and Barcelona Port. Its stylish, air-conditioned rooms feature free WiFi and a satellite TV.

Hotel SERHS Del Port´s modern rooms offer a safe. The private bathrooms come with a hairdryer and free toiletries.

Montjuïc Hill is within a 10-minute walk of Hotel SERHS Del Port. A funicular train connects Montjuïc with Paral-lel Metro Station, located 500 metres from the hotel.

Direct Metro services also connect Paral-lel to Plaça Catalunya Square, Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard and Gaudí’s famous Parc Guëll. Hotel SERHS Del Port´s tour desk can provide information about the city.

SERHS Carlit Boutique Hotel is located in Barcelona, 900 metres from the iconic Sagrada Família Basilica and Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard. It offers a 24-hour reception and air-conditioned rooms, all with free WiFi and a flat-screen satellite TV.

The Serhs Carlit is a 10-minute walk from Arc de Triomf, with Ciutadella Park and the trendy Born district just beyond. You can walk to the Agbar Tower in 15 minutes.

Tetuan Metro Station is just 200 metres away, just 1 stop away from Passeig de Gràcia. Estació del Nord Bus Station is 750 metres away.

The hotel has a café-bar serving a daily buffet breakfast, as well as snacks and drinks throughout the day. Staff at reception can provide information about what to see and do in Barcelona, as well as offering restaurant recommendations.

Exe Mitre enjoys a peaceful location in the San Gervasi district of Barcelona, 200 metres from Putxet Park. It offers spacious rooms with and free WiFi.

An extensive buffet breakfast is served, with hot and cold options. The friendly staff are happy to recommend restaurants and bars nearby.

The elegant rooms at Exe Mitre feature classic décor and come with a flat-screen TV. Some rooms also have a terrace with views over Mount Tibidabo.

Exe Mitre is just 15 minutes’ walk from Gaudi’s famous Park Guell. Putxet Metro Station is 200 metres away and connects with Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard in just 6 minutes. Plaza Catalunya and Las Ramblas are an 8-minute metro ride away.

This modern hotel has 250 spacious and fully equipped rooms, a Snack-Bar open 24 hours where clients can enjoy a buffet breakfast, as well as light meals for lunch and dinner. It also has vending machines and private paid parking. All its facilities are perfectly adapted and accessible for people with reduced mobility.
It is a hotel with free and unlimited high-speed Wi-Fi in the common areas. Wi-Fi internet is available in the rooms at an extra cost.
Travelodge Barcelona Poblenou is a pet-friendly hotel that will be happy to offer you and your pet the best experience.
It is located in the traditional Poblenou neighborhood, within streets full of restaurants, bars and shops. One of the most charming neighborhoods in the city, and 600 meters from the Bogatell beach. Barcelona city center can be reached in 10 minutes by metro and Barcelona’s Port Olímpic, with its vibrant night life, is just a 20-minute walk away.
This is considered the most innovative neighborhood in the city. It´s in the heart of the 22@ District and concentrates a multitude of technology and R+D companies. Therefore, thanks to its location and facilities, it is also a perfect accommodation for business trips.
Travelodge Barcelona Poblenou offers all you need to have the best experience in Barcelona city.

This spacious and modern hotel is located in Eixample district, built in 2004, the Leonardo Hotel Barcelona Gran Via, features wide-open public spaces covered in marble.

Rooms include flat-screen TV, Wifi, safebox, desk, minibar, private bathrooms with toiletries.

A good location for tourism, you can easily walk to the Gothic Quarter and Ramblas, or up to the attractions of Montjuic. The city’s major business districts are also nearby.

Rooms include satellite TV, free Wi-Fi access, air conditioning and a bathroom with free toiletries.

Parking is available on site at an additional cost.

Located in Barcelona, 1.1 km from Casa Batllo, The Corner Hotel provides accommodation with an outdoor swimming pool, private parking, a bar and a terrace. Among the facilities at this property are a 24-hour front desk and room service, along with free WiFi throughout the property. Guests can have a drink at the snack bar.

All units at the hotel include air conditioning, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels,and a private bathroom with a bath or shower, bathrobes and slippers. At The Corner Hotel every room comes with bed linen and towels.

A buffet breakfast is available daily at the accommodation.

Popular points of interest near The Corner Hotel include Passeig de Gracia, Plaça Catalunya and La Pedrera. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 12 km from the hotel.

Yurbban Trafalgar Hotel features a rooftop terrace with a pool providing 360 degree panoramic views of Barcelona. The hotel is located just 300 metres from Urquinaona Metro Station.

All rooms are soundproof and air-conditioned, equipped with free WiFi and a flat-screen TV with cable channels. A safety deposit box is also available. Bathrooms has a shower and a hairdryer.

Yurbban Trafalgar Hotel also offers a gym, a bar and a restaurant. A tour desk and laundry facilities are available.

Shops, bars and restaurants can be found within metres from the hotel. Plaza Catalunya is a 10-minute walk away and Barcelona El Prat Airport is 13 km away.

Hotel del Mar is set in a listed building just 800 metres from the seafront and Barceloneta Metro Station. It is a 5-minute walk from the trendy Born neighbourhood and Ciutadella Park.

The air-conditioned rooms at Hotel del Mar have flat-screen satellite TV. There is a private bathroom with a hairdryer and amenities, and some rooms have a private balcony. A safe is also available with a surcharge.

Hotel del Mar has a 24-hour front desk. Barcelona’s França Train Station is a 5-minute walk away, and you can walk to Barcelona Cathedral and Maremagnum Shopping Centre in 10 minutes. Parking is available 5 minutes' walk from the property.

Attractively set in the centre of Barcelona, Occidental Diagonal 414 features air-conditioned rooms, an outdoor swimming pool, free WiFi and a fitness centre. Boasting room service, this property also has a restaurant and a terrace. Private parking is available on site.

The rooms are fitted with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, minibar, a kettle, a shower, free toiletries and a wardrobe. Rooms come with a private bathroom with a hairdryer, while certain rooms are equipped with a balcony and others also boast city views. All guest rooms have a safety deposit box.

Guests at the hotel can enjoy a buffet breakfast.

Speaking Catalan, German, English and Spanish at the 24-hour front desk, staff are always at hand to help.

Popular points of interest near Occidental Diagonal 414 include La Pedrera, Passeig de Gracia and Casa Batllo. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 14 km from the property.

Hostal Operaramblas is situated less than 100 metres from Las Ramblas and Liceu Metro Station. This guest house features rooms with private bathrooms, a 24-hour front desk and free Wi-Fi.

The Operaramblas’ rooms offers simple décor with tiled floors. Each room has heating (in winter), air conditioning (in summer) and a telephone.

The guest house has an ideal location in the centre of Barcelona. It is 5 minutes’ walk from the Gothic Quarter, where there are a range of cafés, bars and restaurants. The city’s cathedral is 500 metres from the Opera and the Old Port is less than 10 minutes’ walk away.

This stylish hotel has an excellent central location, 50 metres from Barcelona’s Las Ramblas and just 100 metres from Plaza Catalunya. It offers a rooftop pool, sauna and free Wi-Fi.

Rooms at the Silken Ramblas are stylish, and are equipped with a flat-screen satellite TV and a minibar. There is central heating and air conditioning according to the season. The private bathroom comes with a hairdryer.

The Silken has a restaurant and bar. Room service is available. There is a also a pleasant terrace.

The Silken has a tour desk and the sightseeing bus stops nearby in Plaza Catalunya.

Pestana Arena Barcelona is less than 5 minutes’ walk from Barcelona’s Plaza Espanya and Fira Exhibition Centre. It offers a gym, sauna and modern, air-conditioned rooms with free wired internet access.

Some rooms offers free use of the Maritimo Meeting Room, up to 12 people, for private meetings.

Pestana Arena Barcelona is just 3 minutes’ walk from Las Arenas Shopping Centre and you can walk to Sants Station in 8 minutes. You can get to the Rambla in 5 minutes from Plaza Espanya Metro.

Rooms feature parquet floors and stylish décor. Each one has work desk, a pillow menu and an LCD TV with satellite channels.

The hotel’s restaurant serves Mediterranean food and has a terrace. There is also a bar where you can get a snack or a drink. The hotel's breakfast includes products for celiacs.

Until further notice, the use of jacuzzi is prohibited due to the existing drought in Catalonia.

Set just off Plaça d’Espanya and at the foot of Montjuïc, Hotel Acta Azul Barcelona offers stylish accommodation in central Barcelona. It features a roof terrace, 24-hour reception and free Wi-Fi.

Las Ramblas and the city’s Gothic Quarter can be reached in less than 10 minutes, by Metro and here you will find where a selection of bars and restaurants.

Each of the Azul’s spacious rooms has bright décor and wooden flooring. All rooms have air conditioning, satellite TV and a desk.

The hotel is a 5-minute walk from Barcelona’s Fira Conference Centre and Plaça d’Espanya’s Magic Fountains. Montjuïc Park and the MNAC Gallery are within 1 km of the hotel. The bullring-turned-shopping centre of Las Arenas is next door.

Situated on Barcelona’s famous Las Ramblas, Hostal Benidorm offers free Wi-Fi, 24-hour reception and air-conditioned rooms with satellite TV. Liceu Metro Station is just 200 metres away.

Each room at the Benidorm Hostal features simple décor and tiled floors. All rooms have central heating and a private bathroom.

Drinks and snacks are available from vending machines in the Benidorm’s reception area. Staff at the front desk can provide information about the city and arrange car or bicycle rental.

Hostal Benidorm is located just outside the historic Gothic Quarter. Gaudi’s Palau Güell is 100 metres away, while the Boqueria Market is within 400 metres. Barceloneta Beach can be reached in 25 minutes’ walk or a 10-minute bus.

Feelathome Plaza Apartments offers apartments with free Wi-Fi and heating. The apartments are 100 metres from Hostafrancs Metro Station and 650 metres from Plaza Espanya and Barcelona Fira Congress Centre.

Featuring stylish décor, all the apartments include a seating area, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels and a DVD player. Most of the apartments have a balcony or terrace. Every apartment has access to a communal rooftop terrace with views of the area.

Each apartment has a dining area and a kitchen equipped with a washing machine, oven and coffee machine. The bathrooms come with a shower and bed linen and towels are provided.

Guests will find restaurants and shops within 3 minutes' walk from the property. The apartments are 3 km from Plaza Catalunya Square and Barcelona city centre. Sants Train Station is a 10-minute walk from the property.

hotel_name: Leonardo Boutique Hotel Barcelona Sagrada Familia
description:
Leonardo Boutique Hotel Barcelona Sagrada Familia is located just 15 minutes’ walk from Gaudí’s famous Sagrada Familia. It has a rooftop sun terrace with panoramic views of Barcelona and rooms with free Wi-Fi.

All modern, outward-facing rooms at theLeonardo Boutique Hotel Barcelona Sagrada Familia are equipped with air conditioning and heating. They have a flat-screen TV and the private bathrooms come with a hairdryer.

Leonardo Boutique Hotel Barcelona Sagrada Familia serves a daily buffet breakfast, and gluten-free meals are available on prior request. In summer, breakfast can be enjoyed on the terrace. There are also vending machines with snacks and drinks.

Staff at the hotel’s 24-hour reception can provide information about what to see and do in Barcelona. Clot Metro Station is 200 metres away, allowing you to reach the city centre in 10 minutes.

hotel_name: Labtwentytwo Barcelona, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel
description:
Set in Barcelona, 1.9 km from Nova Mar Bella Beach, Labtwentytwo Barcelona, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel offers accommodation with an outdoor swimming pool, private parking, a fitness centre and a terrace. This 4-star hotel offers a business centre, a concierge service and free WiFi. Guests can make use of a bar.

At the hotel every room includes air conditioning, a seating area, a flat-screen TV with cable channels, a safety deposit box and a private bathroom with a shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer. Labtwentytwo Barcelona, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel provides certain units with city views, and all rooms come with a coffee machine. The units will provide guests with a desk and a kettle.

A buffet, à la carte or continental breakfast is available at the property. At the accommodation you will find a restaurant serving Middle Eastern and international cuisine. Vegetarian, dairy-free and vegan options can also be requested.

Speaking German, English, Spanish and French, staff will be happy to provide guests with practical information on the area at the reception.

Llevant is 2.1 km from Labtwentytwo Barcelona, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel, while Mar Bella Beach is 2.1 km away. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 17 km from the property.

Catalonia La Boqueria hotel is set in the centre of Barcelona’s old town, a few metres from Las Ramblas. This stylish hotel offers free WiFi and rooms with satellite TV.

Catalonia La Boqueria hotel features contemporary design and modern rooms decorated elegantly. Each room has air conditioning, a minibar and a desk.

Catalonia La Boqueria hotel is ideally situated for visiting Barcelona’s main attractions. There are several restaurants, bars and cafés in the nearby Gothic Quarter and the famous Boquería Market is less than 100 metres away.

Barcelona Port is a 10-minute walk from the hotel and the city’s cathedral is one kilometre away. Liceu Metro Station and Liceu Theatre are a 1-minute walk from the Catalonia La Boqueria hotel.

Room Mate Carla is set 200 metres from Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard, and 5-minutes’ walk from Gaudí’s La Pedrera in Barcelona’s Eixample District. It features free WiFi and colourful, stylish rooms.

Decorated with lively prints, the air-conditioned rooms include a flat-screen TV, minibar, safe and a private bathroom.

Room Mate Carla features a modern bar offering a range of cocktails. You will also find a terrace and meeting rooms on site.

The hotel is a 15-minute walk from the Sagrada Familia Cathedral. Verdaguer and Diagonal Metro Stations are 500 metres away and offer easy access to Las Ramblas and Sants Train Station.

Hotel Ramblas Internacional is set right on the famous Las Ramblas, 50 metres from Liceu Metro Station and close to La Boquería Market.
Each of the soundproofed rooms is individually decorated and has plenty of natural light. Most rooms offer views of central Barcelona and some look onto Las Ramblas.

Hotel Ramblas Internacional serves a daily breakfast.

Located just 150 metres from Liceu Theatre, the hotel has easy access to Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter and the city’s cathedral is less than 10 minutes’ walk away.

Situated 350 metres from Paseo de Gracia Boulevard, Hotel Arconte is an eco-friendly hotel with a small outdoor pool, sauna and terrace. Provença Train Station is 200 metres away.

The Hotel Arconte's air-conditioned rooms feature elegant white décor and various mirrors. They offer free WiFi, and LCD TVs in the bedroom and bathroom. Bathrooms also include a bathrobes and slippers.

The Hotel Arconte offers a spacious reception area with a lobby bar.

You will find shopping areas nearby.

Diagonal Metro Station is within 400 metres of Hotel Arconte. Gaudi’s Casa Milà and the popular Gràcia district can be reached in an 8-minute walk.

AC Hotel Sants is located just 50 metres from Barcelona Sants Train Station. It offers 24-hour reception and modern, air-conditioned rooms with a satellite TV and free safe.

Each room features special reading lamps, 4 pillows and elegant furnishings. They come equipped with a desk and a minibar. Some rooms offer city views.

Free WiFi is available in the lobby and bar. The restaurant inside the property serves a breakfast buffet every morning.

AC Hotel Sants is around 500 metres from Plaça Espanya and Montjuic. Sants Station offers direct metro access to Plaça Catalunya and Las Ramblas, as well as direct access to El Prat Airport.

Boasting a terrace, a restaurant as well as a bar, Casa Pince is situated in the centre of Barcelona, 2 km from Sant Miquel Beach. This 3-star hotel offers a concierge service and a tour desk. The accommodation features a 24-hour front desk, airport transfers, room service and free WiFi throughout the property.

The hotel will provide guests with air-conditioned rooms offering a desk, a coffee machine, a minibar, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a shower. The rooms come with a kettle, while selected rooms also feature a balcony and others also feature city views. All rooms have a wardrobe.

An à la carte, continental or American breakfast can be enjoyed at the property.

Popular points of interest near Casa Pince include Plaça Reial, Plaça Catalunya and Portal de l'Angel. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 13 km from the property.

Offering a rooftop pool and terrace,  NH Collection Barcelona Constanza has modern rooms with satellite TV. It is located next to L’Illa Shopping Centre on Diagonal Avenue, 15 minutes' walk from Sants Train Station.

The elegant, modern rooms at the Constanza feature a Nespresso machine, flat-screen TV, and pillow menu, while the bathroom includes a rain shower and a professional hairdryer. Free WiFi is included.

Guests can use the spa for an extra cost: please, note that the spa is included for stays in Premium rooms, Junior suites and Suite. The gym is available free of charge. Room service is available 24 hours.

The hotel's Antiox healthy buffet breakfast features antioxidant dishes made with ecological produce.

The hotel is 15 minutes’ walk from Barcelona FC’s Camp Nou Stadium. María Cristina Metro Station is 10 minutes’ walk away, connecting you with the Fira Exhibition Centre in under 10 minutes.

Hotel Market is located next to Barcelona’s San Antonio Market, 10 minutes' walk from MACBA Gallery. Its chic rooms have rain showers and free Wi-Fi, and there is a popular restaurant.

The Market Hotel’s modern rooms have dark wood beams, white walls and large windows. Each one has a private bathroom. Some rooms have a balcony or terrace.

The hotel is 15 minutes’ walk from both Plaza Espanya and Plaza Catalunya. Sant Antoni Metro Station is about 200 metres away, and an airport shuttle bus stop can be found 2 minutes’ away.

The Market Hotel’s elegant restaurant offers a range of modern Catalan dishes, and specializes in rice.

Set 600 metres from Barcelona’s central Passeig de Gracia, Hotel Europark offers a rooftop terrace with outdoor pool. The stylish rooms include a 32-inch LCD TV and free Wi-Fi access.

Each air-conditioned room at the Europark has elegant black and white décor. There is a laptop safe and minibar, as well as a modern bathroom with hairdryer.

Hotel Europark has a café-bar and a breakfast room, where a varied buffet breakfast is served. A free early-morning coffee service is also available.

The hotel is a 15-minute walk from Plaça Catalunya and Las Ramblas. Girona Metro Station is just 200 metres away and provides direct access to Barceloneta Beach and the Gothic Quarter.

Located just 8 minutes’ walk from central Barcelona’s Plaza Catalunya, Hotel HCC Taber is housed in an impressive Modernist building. It offers air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi.

The rooms at HCC Taber feature satellite TV and a minibar. The private bathroom includes a hairdryer and free toiletries.

The building of the HCC Taber was originally designed by the famous Barcelona architect, Domènech i Montaner, who also designed the amazing Palau de la Música Catalana. It still retains its characteristic wrought-iron balconies and large bay windows.

The hotel’s buffet breakfast offers a wide range of dishes, and there are à-la-carte breakfast options. There is also a snack bar and room service.

The Ramblas are just 10 minutes’ walk from the hotel, and Gaudí’s iconic Casa Batlló and La Pedrera are also within a 10-minute walk. Airport buses leave from Plaza Catalunya.

Situated above Barcelona Sants Train Station, Barceló Sants offers a subtle outer space theme throughout. Minimalist rooms feature free Wi-Fi, rain showers, and large windows with city views.

Air-conditioned rooms feature modern décor and designer furniture. Each has an iPod dock, flat-screen TV, and tea and coffee making facilities. The bathroom comes with a hairdryer.

This design hotel includes a fitness centre.

The hotel has the Oxygen restaurant, where you can enjoy a delicious, complete and healthy breakfast buffet. It also has the Orbital Bar, the ideal space to disconnect from daily life; a fun and perfect place to have a delicious cocktail with your partner or to hang out and have a drink with colleagues after a long working day.

Sants Train and Metro Station offers direct access to Barcelona Airport, and the historic city centre, 3.5 km away. There are also high-speed AVE services to Madrid and international trains.

There is a 24-hour front desk, and you can hire a car from the tour desk. On-site parking is available for an extra charge and the hotel has a Wi-Fi zone.

Hotel Vilamarí is set 250 metres from Plaza de Espanya Metro Station and the Fira de Barcelona Exhibition Centre. This hotel features a terrace and a small gym with Turkish Bath.

The Vilamarí’s rooms have simple, elegant décor and dark wood furniture. Each room includes flat-screen satellite TV. The stylish bathrooms come with amenities and a hairdryer. The hotel features centrally controlled air conditioned or heating depending on the season.

Barcelona’s MNAC Art Museum and the Magic Fountains are within a 10-minute walk of the hotel. Las Arenas Shopping Centre is just 200 metres away. Barcelona Port is a 15-minute metro ride away and Barcelona Beach can be reached in 35 minutes.

Located in Barcelona’s trendy Born district, Park Hotel offers stylish accommodation just 10 minutes' walk from Barceloneta Beach, opposite to Estació de França Station. Reception is open 24 hours a day. Free WiFi is offered throughout the property.

The air-conditioned rooms at the Hotel Park feature modern décor in warm tones. They are equipped with flat-screen satellite TV, and soundproofing.

A buffet breakfast is served daily in the hotel’s bright café; and a wide variety of tapas are served at the on-site Ten's Tapas Restaurant, from the awarded-winning chef Jordi Cruz.

Park Hotel is just 200 metres from Mercat del Born public market and from Ciudadela Park, where you can find Barcelona Zoo.

Barceloneta Metro Station, located 300 metres from the hotel, connects you with the city centre in just 5 minutes.

Set in Barcelona within 600 metres of Barceloneta Beach and 600 metres of Somorrostro Beach, Barceloneta Suites Apartments Market offers accommodation with free WiFi, seating area and a kitchen. There is a private entrance at the apartment for the convenience of those who stay. Outdoor seating allows guests to sit outside and enjoy the good weather.

The apartment complex will provide guests with air-conditioned units offering a desk, a coffee machine, an oven, a fridge, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a walk-in shower. Units are equipped with a kettle, while selected rooms will provide you with a balcony and others also have city views. At the apartment complex, the units have bed linen and towels.

Guests can also relax on the sun terrace.

Popular points of interest near the apartment include Sant Miquel Beach, Santa Maria del Mar and Picasso Museum. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 13 km away.

Granvia is set in an impressive 19th-century building, 100 metres from the shops and restaurants of Passeig de Gràcia. This luxurious hotel has free WiFi and a terrace.

Each stylish room has high ceilings, satellite TV and air conditioning. The private bathrooms include a bath tub or shower and hairdryer.

A buffet breakfast is served daily and guests can enjoy a drink on the attractive terrace at the back of the hotel.

Plaza de Catalunya and Las Ramblas are less than 500 metres from the hotel. Gaudí’s Casa Batlló and La Pedrera are a 10-minute walk away.

This design hotel offers free WiFi and is just 400 metres from Sagrada Família Church. Decorated in elegant neutral tones, rooms include a plasma screen TV with satellite channels.

Rooms at the Eurostars Monumental have wooden floors and modern lighting. Toiletries and a hairdryer are included in the stylish marble bathrooms.

A breakfast buffet is served in the hotel’s restaurant. You can also find various restaurants and cafés within a 5-minute walk, in the area around the Sagrada Familia.

Eurostars Monumental is 100 metres from Monumental Metro Station, which provides direct trains to Passeig de Gracia Station. Estació del Nord Bus Station is just 850 metres away. The property offers a parking space for luggage drop off in front of the hotel.

Negresco Princess is situated in Barcelona in the Catalonia Region. The hotel has an outdoor pool and sun terrace, and guests can enjoy a meal at the restaurant.

Each room at this hotel is air conditioned and is fitted with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels.  For your comfort, you will find free toiletries and a hair dryer. Negresco Princess features free WiFi throughout the property.

There is a 24-hour front desk at the property.

Plaça Catalunya is 400 metres from Negresco Princess, while Portal de l'Angel is 500 metres away. The nearest airport is El Prat Airport, 13 km from Negresco Princess.

Located 5 minutes’ walk from Les Corts Metro Station, this hotel offers modern accommodation in Barcelona. It has good access to the city's main attractions, such as the Nou Camp Football Stadium.

The air-conditioned rooms at the NH Barcelona Les Corts feature contemporary décor, free Wi-Fi, satellite TV and a private balcony or terrace. The private bathroom has a hairdryer and toiletries.

The hotel operates a tour desk and a 24-hour reception. Helpful staff can organise bicycle and car rental, as well as provide information on Barcelona.

NH Les Corts is less than 10 minutes’ walk from Sants Train Station, providing access to Barcelona Airport. L’Illa Diagonal Shopping Centre is just 300 metres away. Barcelona Airport is 15 km from the property.

This family-run hotel is within 200 metres of Las Ramblas and Plaza Catalunya. All rooms are made of natural, organic materials and painted with PVC-free paint.
All rooms at Hostal Grau have a private bathroom with free toiletries made from natural sources such as lavender. Some rooms have a balcony; while others face a vertical garden.
The whole building features energy efficient lighting and a water recycling system, as well as using renewable or clean energy.
Free natural teas and infusions, are available from the on-site lounge.
The MACBA Modern Art Museum is just 350 metres from the guest house, and Port Vell Harbour is a 15-minute walk away. Direct buses to Barcelona Airport stop in nearby Plaza Universitat.

The modern Hotel Grums is located in central Barcelona, 5 minutes' walk from Barcelona’s port, ferry terminal and cruise terminal. The Ramblas are 600 metres away, and Parallel Metro Station 300 metres away.

Hotel Grums Barcelona offers elegant, bright and spacious rooms with themed design décor and panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows. There is free high-speed WiFi available throughout.

All our rooms have free RITUALS Cosmetics amenities.

The Hotel Grums Barcelona features a wellness spa which is not included in the room rate and can be accessed for a small surcharge. Guests can relax in the hot tub, Finnish sauna or steam bath. A selection of massage and treatments are also available at an extra cost.

Hotel Regina Barcelona is set in a historic 19th-century building, just 50 metres from Barcelona’s Plaza Catalunya and the Ramblas. The hotel offers free high-speed WiFi and modern rooms.

The century-old hotel was founded in 1917 and features beautiful architecture, including its impressive art nouveau entrance.

The Hotel Regina Barcelona’s spacious rooms come with air conditioning, central heating and satellite TV. There is free tea and coffee, a safe, work desk and minibar. The private bathroom includes ecological cosmetics and a hairdryer. Some rooms have a balcony.

A varied buffet breakfast with zero-kilometre and homemade products is served. There is also a bar and room service is offered all day from 07:00 to 00:00.

The Regina has a 24-hour front desk and a tour desk. Gaudí’s Casa Batlló and La Pedrera, on Passeig de Gràcia Avenue, are within a 10-minute walk away. Catalunya Metro and Train Station and the airport bus stop are within 5 minutes' walk.

Set in Barcelona’s vibrant Raval district, this design hotel offers free Wi-Fi, a gym and a roof terrace with pool and panoramic views. Some rooms include a Nespresso coffee machine.

Each bright, air-conditioned room at the Barceló Raval features a large plasma-screen TV with more than 70 channels. Rooms have a minibar and a modern bathroom.

Hotel Barceló Raval’s B-Lounge serves creative Mediterranean food, tapas and cocktails in stylish surroundings. You can also enjoy a drink on the outdoor terrace.

The Raval Barceló is only a 5-minute walk from the MACBA Modern Art Gallery. Liceu Metro Station, Las Ramblas and the famous Boqueria Market are all just 400 metres away.

This motorcycle-friendly hotel is 3 Metro stops from Plaza Catalunya and 15 minutes’ walk from the Barcelona’s beaches. There is free WiFi available throughout.

Capri by Fraser Barcelona offers chic air-conditioned and spacious suites and apartments with a flat-screen cable TV and a seating area. There is a fully-equipped kitchenette, a work desk and a safe, and the private bathroom comes with a hairdryer and amenities.

The property has a free self-service laundry room open 24 hours a day and a gym.

For guests coming by motorcycle, Capri by Fraser offers free indoor parking with direct elevator to the rooms and a “pit stop” service including complete toolkit for small repairs and chain lubricant, free suede, helmet visor cleaner, battery charger and compressor to check the pressure level of tyres.

Capri by Fraser Barcelona offers a buffet breakfast every day and a set menu at lunch time during week days. Room service is also available.

The hotel has a 24-hour front desk.

Offering a 1960’s vibe and rooms with vintage décor, this hotel is set in the heart of Barcelona, only 2 minutes’ walk from the famous Ramblas.  Free Wi-Fi is available throughout.

Each air-conditioned room at Sixties Ramblas features a TV and a private bathroom. Most rooms have a balcony.

Sixties Ramblas has a bar and a restaurant. Staff at the 24-hour reception can provide tourist information about the area. Bike rental services are also available, and there is also a stylish white billiards table.

The nearest Metro Station is Drassanes, only 2 minutes’ walk from the hotel. You can also walk to the harbour or Plaza Catalunya Square in less than 10 minutes.

Sixties Ramblas is close to the Born district, with numerous trendy bars and restaurants serving local and international food.

This hotel is located next to Avinguda Diagonal and Passeig de Gràcia, ideal for shopping. Guests can easily access Plaza Cataluña and the city’s historic gothic quarter. Free Wi-Fi is available.

Situated along the modernist route, Hotel Catalonia Gracia is surrounded by much of the interesting architecture that Barcelona is famous for, such as Gaudí and Domenech i Muntaner's key buildings, including La Pedrera.

A buffet breakfast is available at the on-site restaurant; room service is also available.

Guests can easily enjoy this cosmopolitan city as Hotel Catalonia Gracia is within walking distance of Barcelona’s many attractions. As well as the excellent public transport links providing swift access to the entire city and the surrounding area, the hotel offers great value for money. The hotel also includes meeting amenities and conference rooms available for business events and banquets.

Located between the Gothic Quarter and the fashionable Born district, this stylish hotel has a fitness centre and free WiFi in all areas.

Barcelona Cathedral is just 200 metres from the Ilunion Almirante, and guests can walk to the famous Las Ramblas in less than 10 minutes. Jaume I Metro Station is 300 metres from the hotel.

Rooms feature wooden furniture and an en suite bathroom with marble finishes. They all include a large flat-screen TV with satellite channels, safe and minibar.

This hotel is officially adapted for guests with reduced mobility, accessible rooms are available on request, also for people with auditory and visual impairment.

The Ilunion Almirante features a stylish breakfast room where an à-la-carte breakfast is served daily. Room service is available during limited hours.

This hotel is officially adapted for guests with reduced mobility.

Located in Barcelona's Plaza de España, Hotel Catalonia Barcelona Plaza offers a seasonal rooftop pool and a terrace with panoramic city views. It also has a fitness room, beauty salon and free Wi-Fi.

The property is located next to Espanya Metro Station. In the square there are numerous bus stops that connect with other parts of the city, with the Fira Barcelona fairground and with Barcelona airport.

All spacious rooms are equipped with air conditioning, satellite TV, a safe and a private marble bathroom with hairdryer. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout, and Smart TVs with Chromecast apps are available. Choose one of the two clock suites and you will have incredible views of Montjuïc from the floor-to-ceiling windows. If you prefer, the hotel also has rooms and suites with private terrace.

The Catalonia Barcelona Plaza serves a daily buffet breakfast in the Simultáneo space, Barcelona's new meeting point that fuses cultural and leisure activities with the best gastronomic offer. Come to Simultáneo to telework with free wifi, to have an informal meeting, to enjoy a concert or to have an afterwork cocktail.

Do you already know the  Simultáneo Gastrobar? An avant-garde space that offers unique haute cuisine dishes. If you book half board, you can enjoy the Gastrobar menu during lunch or dinner.
