The Filigrana restaurant specialises in modern Catalan cuisine made with local ingredients. You can also visit the Japanese restaurant Kurai or have a drink on The Clock terrace, overlooking Montjuïc.

The Catalonia Barcelona Plaza has a spacious business centre with 3 large conference rooms and 8 meeting rooms, all equipped with the latest technology.

This is our guests' favourite part of Barcelona, according to independent reviews.

Within 50 metres of La Pedrera and Diagonal Metro Station, Hotel Royal Passeig de Gracia features a terrace bar with panoramic views of Barcelona. This 4-star hotel also has an interior garden.

Hotel Royal Passeig de Gracia is set in a restored building with contemporary architecture. The smart bedrooms come with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, free Wi-Fi and a bathroom with a rain-effect shower.

Casa Batlló is just 5 minutes’ walk from the hotel, while Plaza Catalunya and Las Ramblas are 2 stops from Diagonal Station.

The Gràcia district is within a 5-minute walk, and charming street cafés can be found along the tree-lined Rambla de Catalunya, 200 metres away.

hotel_name: Alexandra Barcelona Hotel, Curio Collection by Hilton
description:
Located between the stylish Paseo de Gràcia and Rambla de Catalunya, Alexandra Barcelona Hotel, Curio Collection by Hilton offers a private terrace with an outdoor pool. Plaza Catalunya is 7 minutes' walk away.

Rooms combine modern and vintage furniture and some feature traditional details like mosaic-tiled floors. They have flat-screen TVs, a minibar, hairdryer and free safe. The TVs have over 50, some international channels and free WiFi.

Solomillo Restaurant is a brasserie, offering guests the option of having meat by weight. The modern Charcuteria serves cheese plates, cold cuts and market products, as well as a variety of cocktails. You can also visit the Patio, Terrace & Pool.

There is a fitness room and guests can make use of the chromatic sauna for free. Massages are available on request for an extra cost.

Alexandra Barcelona Hotel, Curio Collection by Hilton is just 5 minutes’ walk from Gaudí’s impressive Casa Batlló and La Pedrera. Passeig de Gràcia Train Station is 5 minutes’ walk away, with a direct route to the Barcelona Airport.

Offering free private parking and free WiFi, La França Travellers is located next to Montjiuic, 10-minute walk from Plaza de España and Fira de Barcelona. 24-hour reception is available.

This adults-only guesthouse boasts modern décor and air-conditioned rooms with a flat-screen satellite TV. All have a private bathroom with a hairdryer and free toiletries. All suites have a spa bath and some have a round bed.

Bars, restaurants and several dining options can be found in the surrounding streets.

Regular airport buses leave from a bus stop located just 500 metres away.

Catalonia Gran Via BCN is set on Gran Vía and within 5 minutes’ walk of Urgell and Universitat Metro Stations, and beside the airport bus stop. It features an outdoor swimming pool, a gym and free Wi-Fi.

Each of the modern rooms at Catalonia Gran Via BCN is themed around a different city and air travel. All rooms have flat-screen TVs with satellite channels and an iPod docking station.

You can enjoy breakfast in Catalonia Gran Via BCN, while à la carte options are offered in the Gourmet Corner.

You can walk to both Plaza Catalunya and Las Ramblas in 10 minutes. Plaza de España, the Magic Fountains and the FIRA are just 2 stops from Urgell Station.

Ako Suites Hotel offers stylish apartments with free Wi-Fi and modern kitchenettes. It is located a 10-minute walk from Plaza Catalunya Square.

The Ako Suites have a sleek minimalist design and are decorated in light colours. A flat-screen TV and a double sofa bed can be found in each air-conditioned apartment.

Kitchenettes include a ceramic hob and a microwave. The elegant bathrooms have a bath or shower. Towels and amenities are also provided.

Ako Suites Hotel is located just 300 metres from Universitat Metro Station and a 5-minute walk from an airport bus stop. Staff at the 24-hour reception is happy to provide information about the city.

Featuring a rooftop terrace with a seasonal swimming pool and hot tub, as well as panoramic views of Barcelona, Sunotel Aston is a 3-minute walk from Hospital Clinic Metro Station.

Air-conditioned rooms include a flat-screen TV, soundproofed windows and a private bathroom with a hairdryer. Free, high-speed WiFi is available.

An extensive buffet breakfast is served at the hotel. The hotel’s Pa'l Caldero Restaurant offers a wide selection of dishes from around the world. There are also many eating options in the area.

Sunotel Aston has a 24-hour reception and offers services such as luggage storage, free pool towels and free bikes.

Plaza Catalunya and the Ramblas can be reached in around 15 minutes by public transport; while Barcelona’s famous Sagrada Familia Cathedral is around 10 minutes away.

MH Apartments Sant Pau are located just 7 minutes’ walk from Gaudi’s famous Sagrada Família, in Barcelona. These modern, air-conditioned apartments feature free WiFi and a flat-screen TV.

MH Apartments Sant Pau have parquet floors. There is also a washing machine and dishwasher. Bed linen and towels are provided.

There are various restaurants, bars and supermarkets located in the streets around the apartments. The charming Bohemian district of Gràcia is just 5 minutes' walk away.

The amazing Hospital de Sant Pau, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is just 8 minutes’ walk from the apartments. Located a 7-minute walk away, Joanic Metro Station connects you with Barcelona City Centre and the Gothic Quarter in under 10 minutes.

Private parking is available 300 metres from the property, for an extra cost.

Situated within 1.9 km of Somorrostro Beach and 180 meters of Boqueria Market, Hostal La Terrassa features rooms with air conditioning and a private bathroom in Barcelona. Boasting a terrace, this property is set a short distance from Cathedral of Barcelona, Passeig de Gracia and Plaça Catalunya. The accommodation offers a 24-hour front desk, a tour desk and ticket service for guests.

At the guest house, rooms come with a wardrobe.

Plaça Reial is 500 meters from Hostal La Terrassa, while Portal de l'Angel is 950 meters from the property. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 15 km from the accommodation.

Located in Barcelona, 2.3 km from Sant Sebastian Beach and 1 km from the centre, Stay U-nique Apartments Est provides air-conditioned accommodation with free WiFi, and a terrace. It is situated 2.3 km from Sant Miquel Beach and features a lift. The apartment features family rooms.

Each unit is equipped with a balcony, a fully equipped kitchen with an oven, a seating area, a TV, a washing machine, and a private bathroom with shower and a hair dryer. A microwave, a toaster and fridge are also provided, as well as a coffee machine and a kettle. At the apartment complex, all units come with bed linen and towels.

Popular points of interest near the apartment include Boqueria Market, Santa Maria del Mar and Picasso Museum. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 12 km from Stay U-nique Apartments Est.

Located within less than 1 km of Sants Railway Station and a 15-minute walk of Magic Fountain of Montjuic, Sweett - Carrer Fira provides rooms with air conditioning and a private bathroom in Barcelona. There is a private entrance at the apartment for the convenience of those who stay. The apartment features family rooms.

All units comprise a seating area with a sofa, a dining area, and a fully equipped kitchen with various cooking facilities, including a dishwasher, an oven, a microwave and a toaster. With a private bathroom equipped with a hair dryer, units at the apartment complex also provide guests with free WiFi, while selected rooms include a balcony. At the apartment complex, all units are fitted with bed linen and towels.

Casa Batllo is 2.2 km from the apartment, while Plaça Catalunya is 2.6 km away. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 11 km from the property.

hotel_name: Hotel Balmes, a member of Preferred Hotels & Resorts
description:
Balmes is located in central Barcelona, 5 minutes’ walk from the famous Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard. It offers a swimming pool, a gym/fitness center and modern rooms with satellite TV.

The air-conditioned rooms at Hotel Balmes feature parquet floors and smart, simple décor. They all come with a private bathroom, a flat-screen TV and free Wi-Fi.

B Bar, like the rest of the hotel, is decorated with works of African art.

Staff at the hotel’s 24-hour reception can help booking tickets for guided tours, live shows and other events. There is a computer in the lobby which guests can use for free.

Gaudí’s Casa Batlló and La Pedrera are both under 10 minutes’ walk from the hotel. You can walk to Las Ramblas and Barcelona’s charming Gothic Quarter in around 15 minutes.

hotel_name: Hotel Indigo Barcelona - Plaza Catalunya 4Sup, an IHG Hotel
description:
Featuring an outdoor swimming pool with a poolside terrace, Hotel Indigo Barcelona - Plaza Catalunya is just 200 metres from Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard. Plaça Catalunya is about 4 minutes’ walk away.

The stylish, air-conditioned rooms in the Hotel Indigo have a flat-screen satellite TV and free WiFi.  Some bathrooms have a spa bath, while all rooms include amenities such as a minibar, coffee maker, scale and daily newspaper delivery. A pillow menu is also offered. Some rooms have a balcony or terrace.

The restaurant, Gastro Bar Catalunya, offers Spanish dishes for breakfast, lunch and dinner.  The 24-hour reception can arrange hire of bicycles and cars, and book tickets for exhibitions and musicals.

The train station offering a connection with Barcelona Airport is about 6 minutes’ walk away. Gaudi’s famous La Pedrera is just 10 minutes’ walk away.

A great range of bars and restaurants can be found in the area surrounding the Indigo Hotel.

Situated next to Gràcia FGC Train Station, Hotel Via Augusta has a rooftop terrace with views of Barcelona. It offers functional, air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi and flat-screen satellite TV.

The Via Augusta is a historic building with a beautiful original foyer. Rooms have simple, modern décor and wooden floors. They include a work desk, a safe and a bathroom with a hairdryer.

A varied breakfast buffet is served in the hotel, and drinks are available from the vending machine. A wide range of bars and restaurants can be found in the popular Gràcia district, within a 5-minute walk.

Hotel Via Augusta is 400 metres from Fontana Metro Station, and Parc Güell is just 1 Metro stop away. Plaza Catalunya and Las Ramblas are a 5-minute journey from nearby Gracia Station.

Welcome to The White Flats Les Corts, an exceptional accommodation in the heart of the charming Les Corts neighborhood in Barcelona!

These exclusive 2 or 3-bedroom apartments have been meticulously designed to offer you an experience of maximum comfort and style. Every corner has been carefully decorated with a modern and sophisticated touch, creating a cozy atmosphere that will make you feel at home. Additionally, its spaces are fully equipped with all the necessary amenities to provide you with an ideal stay. From the fully equipped kitchen to the extremely comfortable beds to offer you an optimal experience.

Despite not being in the city center, its location is unbeatable. Just a 5-minute walk away, you will find the Les Corts metro stop, allowing you to easily explore all the wonders that Barcelona has to offer. And if you're a football enthusiast, you'll be delighted to know that we are very close to the iconic Camp Nou stadium, home of the legendary FC Barcelona. In the surroundings, you will discover a wide range of services and amenities that will enrich your experience. From supermarkets where you can stock up to high-quality restaurants, charming cafes, and many shops.

The White Flats Les Corts goal's is to provide you with a truly memorable experience during your visit to Barcelona. An attentive team will always be ready to assist you with anything you need, ensuring that every moment of your stay is exceptional. You are invited to enjoy this accommodation, where they will welcome you with open arms. The White Flats Les Corts look forward to hosting you!

Centrally located, Ola Living Portaferrissa offers air-conditioned apartments and studios with free Wi-Fi and free safe. Accommodations are 100 metres from Ramblas and Plaza Catalunya is 5 minutes’ walk away.

Featuring modern and functional furniture each accommodation comes with a flat-screen cable TV and a fully equipped kitchenette including a coffee machine, microwave and oven. A washing machine, clothes dryer and iron facilities are also provided.

Ola Living Portaferrissa is surrounded by a wide range of bars, restaurant and traditional Spanish Granjas for a snack or a light meal. You can find fresh produce in La Boquería Market, 200 metres away.

You can walk to the Cathedral in 5 minutes from Ola Living Portaferrissa. Lively Plaza Reial is 400 metres away and Barcelona Museum of Contemporary Art is 7 minutes’ walk from accommodations. The closest metro station is Liceu, just 300 metres away.

Set within 300 metres of Barceloneta Beach and 400 metres of Sant Miquel Beach in Barcelona, Barceloneta Suites Apartments Beach offers accommodation with seating area. The property features city views and is 600 metres from Somorrostro Beach and 2.8 km from Mar Bella Beach. When staying at the apartment, guests can use private entrance.

Each unit is fitted with air conditioning, a private bathroom and a well-fitted kitchen including a toaster, fridge, stovetop and kitchenware. The units include a coffee machine, a flat-screen TV, a safety deposit box and free WiFi, while selected rooms also offer a balcony and some have sea views. At the apartment complex, each unit is fitted with bed linen and towels.

Barceloneta Suites Apartments Beach has a sun terrace and a picnic area.

Popular points of interest near the accommodation include Santa Maria del Mar, Picasso Museum and Port Olimpic. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 13 km from the property.

Housed in an attractive 19th-century building, Grupotel Gravina is located just off Plaza Catalunya, Barcelona’s main square, 5 minutes' walk from Las Ramblas. It offers 24-hour reception and modern rooms with free WiFi and satellite TV.

The Hotel Gravina is just 5 minutes’ walk from the MACBA Modern Art Gallery and 15 minutes from Gaudí’s La Pedrera and Casa Batlló. Catalunya Metro Station, located 100 metres from the hotel, connects you with the rest of the city.

The air-conditioned rooms at Grupotel Gravina feature modern furniture and some have parquet floors. They are equipped with a work desk and a private bathroom with a hairdryer.

The hotel has a smart bar where you can get a snack or a drink. There are numerous restaurants in the surrounding streets.

Located in a historic building in the heart of Rambla Catalunya, Mosaic by Ona is situated in Barcelona, 10 minutes' walk from Plaça Catalunya and 5 minutes' walk from Casa Batllo and La Pedrera. Free WiFi is offered throughout the property

Every room at this hotel is air conditioned, and features a flat-screen TV and modern décor. A terrace or balcony are featured in certain rooms. The rooms include a private bathroom fitted with a shower.

Staff at the 24-hour reception can provide information about what to see and do in Barcelona. The hotel also offers car hire.

Due to its central location, several bars and restaurants can be found nearby.

The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 15 km from Mosaic by Ona.

Situated within 1.8 km of Sant Sebastian Beach and 1.8 km of Sant Miquel Beach in the centre of Barcelona, ClassBedroom Gothic Ramblas Apartments features accommodation with free WiFi, seating area and a kitchen. The property is located 800 metres from Picasso Museum, 1.2 km from Passeig de Gracia and less than 1 km from Palau de la Musica Catalana. Tivoli Theatre is 1.3 km away and Plaça Catalunya is 1.1 km from the apartment.

The apartment complex will provide guests with air-conditioned units offering a wardrobe, a coffee machine, a microwave, a toaster, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV, a balcony and a private bathroom with a shower. A fridge and kitchenware are also available, as well as a kettle. At the apartment complex, each unit is fitted with bed linen and towels.

Popular points of interest near the apartment include Barceloneta Beach, Plaça Reial and Santa Maria del Mar. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 12 km from the property, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

Catalonia Roma is 600 metres from Sants AVE Train and Metro Station. It offers free Wi-Fi, and you can reach Barcelona city centre in 10 minutes by Metro or bus.

There are direct train links to Barcelona Airport from Sants Station and the Airport Bus also stops outside it.

The modern, air-conditioned rooms have wooden floors, a mini fridge with complimentary water and satellite TV. There is a safe and minibar, and a private bathroom with a hairdryer.

A buffet breakfast is served at the hotel restaurant. Room service is available and there is also a bar.

Plaza Espanya, Montjuic’s Magic Fountain and the Fira Conference Centre are all within 15 minutes’ walk of the hotel.

The 24-hour front desk at Catalonia Roma boasts a large stained-glass skylight. You can rent a car and currency exchange is offered.

Pets: Only one dog or cat less than 20 kg is allowed per room (on request). Supplement of 22€ night/animal and deposit of 200€.

Featuring a quality bakery within the hotel, Praktik Bakery hotel is located in Barcelona, 5 minutes' walk from Diagonal Metro. Free Wi-Fi is available.

This modern hotel offers air-conditioned double/twin rooms including a flat-screen TV and private bathroom. Towels and bed linen are provided free.

Guests can enjoy breakfast in the hotel and try the breads and pastries from the hotel's traditional bakery. Other services include provision of beach towels, ticket service for tourist bus, laundry, and airport transfers.

Praktik Bakery hotel is within a short walk of many bars, restaurants and shops. Paseo De Gracia Avenue and Gaudi's La Pedrera are just 250 metres away, and La Sagrada Familia is a 15-minute walk away. Plaza Catalunya Sqaure and Las Ramblas Boulevard is 1.3 km from the hotel.

Situated on the famous Ramblas, Hotel SERHS Rivoli Rambla has a beautiful interior courtyard and a terrace from where you can enjoy views over the Gothic Quarter while you sip an espresso.

 Return here for lunch and enjoy views over the urban gardens which date back to the Romantic era.

The Hotel SERHS Rivoli Rambla is a celebration of the Art Deco style which has become a signature of this Catalan city. Enjoy theatrical interiors which combine classic style with avant garde features such as clever lighting and contemporary furniture. Sit in the interior patio of the Rivoli Ramblas where you can enjoy the cool surroundings and murals painted on the walls.

The 128 Rambla Restaurant serves a wide selection of Mediterranean and international cuisine. The varied and appealing buffet breakfast is a great way to help prepare you for the day ahead.

Well situated in the Eixample district of Barcelona, Hotel Sansi Barcelona is set 400 metres from Passeig de Gracia Metro Station, 600 metres from Tivoli Theatre and less than 1 km from Portal de l'Angel. This 4-star hotel offers room service, a 24-hour front desk and free WiFi. The property is 600 metres from Plaça Catalunya, and within 600 metres of the city centre.

The hotel will provide guests with air-conditioned rooms with a desk, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a bath.

Popular points of interest near Hotel Sansi Barcelona include Passeig de Gracia, Casa Batllo and Boqueria Market. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 13 km from the accommodation.

Ramblas Hotel is situated on Barcelona’s famous Las Ramblas, just 500 metres from Port Vell Harbour. It offers free Wi-Fi, a 24-hour reception and air-conditioned rooms with a balcony or terrace.

Each bright room at the Hotel Ramblas includes satellite TV, a minibar and a safe. The private bathrooms come with a hairdryer and toiletries. Some rooms have views over the Ramblas.

The Ramblas Hotel has a lobby bar and a charming café with original Modernista design and a pavement terrace. Breakfast is included in all room rates.

Located at the edge of Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter, the hotel is a 10-minute walk from Barcelona Cathedral. Liceu Metro Station is just 250 metres away.

This design hotel has an excellent location in a quiet side street only 20 metres from the famous Las Ramblas. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. The breakfast combo includes one orange juice, one coffee, one sandwich and one croissant (per person).

The BYPILLOW Twenty is set in the historic centre of Barcelona. It is a short walk from the Boquería Market, the Liceu theatre and the Cathedral.

All rooms at the BYPILLOW Twenty are fully soundproofed and air conditioned. They have flat-screen TV and a free safe.

The hotel rooms and public areas are totally smoke-free. The establishment has a ticket sales service and excursions.

We provide useful information about car or bicycle rental and tour desk.

Located within less than 1 km of Sants Railway Station and 2.5 km of Passeig de Gracia Metro Station, Sweett - Aragon Park Miro provides rooms with air conditioning and a private bathroom in Barcelona. There is a private entrance at the apartment for the convenience of those who stay. Free WiFi is available throughout the property and Magic Fountain of Montjuic is 1.2 km away.

Each unit is equipped with a balcony, a fully equipped kitchen with an oven, a seating area, a flat-screen TV, a washing machine, and a private bathroom with shower and a hair dryer. A microwave, a toaster and fridge are also provided, as well as a coffee machine and a kettle. At the apartment complex, all units come with bed linen and towels.

Casa Batllo is 2.6 km from the apartment, while Passeig de Gracia is 2.8 km away. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 11 km from the property.

Set within a few steps of Passeig de Gracia and 300 metres of La Pedrera, Casa Gracia Apartments offers rooms with air conditioning and a private bathroom in Barcelona. Among the facilities at this property are a 24-hour front desk and a lift, along with free WiFi throughout the property. Featuring a private entrance, the aparthotel allows guests to maintain their privacy.

All units include a seating area, a flat-screen TV, a fully equipped kitchen, a dining area, and a private bathroom, while some feature a terrace or a balcony. At the aparthotel, each unit comes with bed linen and towels.

Popular points of interest near the aparthotel include Casa Batllo, Passeig de Gracia Metro Station and Tivoli Theatre. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 14 km away.

Hotel España is situated in a 19th-century building in central Barcelona, within 100 metres of the Ramblas and Liceu Theatre and 200 metres from Boqueria Market. Its Mediterranean restaurant is run by famous chef Martín Berasategui. There is free high-speed WiFi available throughout.

The stylish and elegant rooms include a flat-screen TV and air conditioning. They also come with a modern bathroom.

Hotel España offers a variety of drinks and cocktails at AlAire rooftop terrace bar. There is also a small swimming pool.

Liceu Metro Station is 100 metres away and the Gothic Quarter is less than 5 minutes’ walk away.

Suites Independencia offers stylish apartments set just 10 minutes’ walk from Gaudí’s Sagrada Familia and 150 metres from Encants Metro Station. It features apartments with cable TV.

The Indepencia’s bright, air-conditioned accommodation has simple, modern décor. Each apartment has a spacious seating area and a well-equipped kitchenette with an oven. Some apartments have a balcony.

The area surrounding the apartments has a varied selection of shops, cafés and restaurants. Sagrada Familia Market is a 10-minute walk away.

Barcelona’s old town and Las Ramblas are just 4 Metro stops from Encants. The beaches at Poblenou are less than 2 km from the Suites Independencia.

Attractively situated in the centre of Barcelona, Hotel Casa Gardenia features air-conditioned rooms, an outdoor swimming pool, free WiFi and a terrace. This 2-star hotel offers luggage storage space. The property is non-smoking and is situated 2.8 km from Sant Sebastian Beach.

The rooms in the hotel are equipped with a flat-screen TV. The private bathroom is fitted with a shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer.

Buffet and continental breakfast options are available each morning at Hotel Casa Gardenia.

Speaking English, Spanish, French and Italian, staff are ready to help around the clock at the reception.

Popular points of interest near the accommodation include Plaça Catalunya, Portal de l'Angel and Passeig de Gracia Metro Station. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 12 km from the property.

The stylish Gran Via 678 is situated 700 metres from Plaza Catalunya in central Barcelona and features an outdoor pool with a sun terrace. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel.

Modern rooms at this design hotel include satellite TV and a minibar. The private bathroom is complete with a hairdryer.

Grupotel Gran Via 678 offers a restaurant which serves Mediterranean and international cuisine. Guests can enjoy meals on the terrace.

Urquinaona Metro Station is 400 metres away while the Arc de Triomf monument is less than 10 minutes’ walk from the hotel.

BGarden BCN is a small and cozy guest-house which offers a personalized service.
Housed in a Art Nouveau building and placed in one of the best locations in Barcelona for travelers, our goal is to make guests feel at home.

It is 10 min by foot to Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard, Plaça Catalunya, Las Ramblas and Arc de Triumf. You can find all kind of shops, restaurants and bars nearby.
As you were in a typical Spanish 1900’s house with authentical vitreaux and high ceilings, B-Garden BCN offers rooms with private balcony and most of them have private and renovated bathrooms.
All the rooms at B-Garden BCN feature tiled floors and stylish dècor, with a mix of antique and modern mobiliary. We offer flat-screen Smart T.V, free Wi-Fi connection and a varied buffet breakfast.
Barcelona’s charming Born district is just 7 minutes’ walk from B-Garden BCN. Here you can find the Palau de la Música Catalana and a Modernist Auditorium.
Tetuán metro station is only 100 metres away and it connects you with the rest of the city, as well as all the buses options in Gran Via de les corts catalanes avenue, just round the corner.

Citytrip Palau de la Música offers studios and apartments located in the lively neighborhood of El Born, one of the most characteristic areas of the city with its typical narrow streets.

The location is very convenient as major tourist attractions such as Las Ramblas, Paseo de Grácia, Arc de Triomf, and Plaça Catalunya are within walking distance.

All accommodations feature attractive, contemporary decor and are carefully designed and equipped to provide all necessary amenities, facilitating an independent and worry-free living experience.

The apartments come equipped with appliances and various kitchen utensils. Free Wi-Fi connection allows you to stay always connected.

There is no reception in the building; the apartments are accessible via codes.

Access to the apartments is by stairs.

Barcelona Center is 400 metres from Barcelona’s Passeig de Gràcia Avenue, and a 15-minute walk from Plaza Catalunya. Guests have free access to the small gym and rooftop hydromassage tub.

The modern rooms at the Barcelona Center Hotel have satellite TV and free WiFi. There is a minibar and safe, and the private bathroom comes with a hairdryer and amenities.

The Center Hotel has a traditional Spanish restaurant. There is also a bar and a rooftop bar.

There is a 24-hour front desk. Parking is available nearby (first to arrive first to take) for an additional charge of 30€ per night and car.

Situated 200 metres from Las Ramblas in central Barcelona, Catalonia Avinyo features a rooftop pool and gym. It offers chic, air-conditioned rooms with satellite TV and free Wi-Fi.

Rooms are decorated in a modern, minimalist style with large wall photos. They include a minibar, safe and telephone. All hotel rooms have smart TVs, which are equipped with Chromecast app. The modern bathrooms have a shower and a hairdryer.

Barceloneta Beach is a 15-minute walk from Hotel Catalonia Avinyo. The Liceu and Jaume I Metro Stations are just 300 metres away and Barcelona Cathedral is 4 minutes' walk away.

The Avinyo’s central location means there are many shops, bars and restaurants close to the hotel. Bicycle and car hire can be arranged at the tour desk.

Situated in a pedestrianised street in the neighbourhood of Borne, Aparthotel Allada 3* offers a tranquil atmosphere due to the scarcity of street noise and the sound-proofing of the building.

Aparthotel Allada 3* is situated in a picturesque, historical area that has maintained the façades and arches of the 17th century, whilst incorporating the modern architecture of the 21st century. The apartments and studios have been designed to offer the greatest comfort and functionality during your stay. All also benefit from ample natural light throughout the day.

The Borne district is full of winding streets that form a labyrinth, allowing you to find some of the most intriguing areas in the old city. Close to the apartments, you will find the church of Saint Mary, the city gardens, the Picasso museum, the chocolate museum, the Cathedral, the market of Saint Catherine as well as many other sites of interest. In addition, you enjoy free access to the Barcelona Egyptian Museum.

With a small rooftop pool offering great views over Barcelona, Andante Hotel is centrally located 350 metres from Drassanes Metro Station and La Rambla. It offers free Wi-Fi and a gym.

Modern air-conditioned rooms feature parquet floors, a laptop safe and flat-screen satellite TV. The bathroom comes with a full-length mirror and a high-powered hairdryer.

A buffet breakfast with show cooking is available. A gluten-free breakfast is available upon request. There is a self-service area with a microwave and vending machines for drinks, sandwiches and snacks, as well as a large terrace.

You can hire a car from the tour desk and a private shuttle from and to Barcelona El Prat Airport is available on prior request at an extra cost. There is a luggage storage room and a laundry and ironing service are offered.

The rooftop terrace will be closed for maintenance from January 15, 2024, to January 25, 2024.

Located just opposite Arc de Triomf, BruStarr Gotic offers rooms in central Barcelona. It is a 10-minute walk from Plaza Catalunya and the Rambla.

The rooms offer a large flat-screen TV, a safe and a private bathroom with a hairdryer. Some rooms have a balcony.

You can find a wide range of dining options, bars and shops in the area around BruStar Gotic-Centric.

Arc de Triomf Metro Station is 100 metres away and there are several bus stops nearby.

Located in Barcelona’s beachfront area of Barceloneta, this design hotel has a stylish terrace overlooking the port. It offers a 24-hour reception, free Wi-Fi and air-conditioned rooms with a smart TV.

The rooms at the Hotel 54 Barceloneta feature modern décor and innovative lighting. Each one has a private bathroom with a hairdryer.

There is a variety of good seafood restaurants within 5 minutes’ walk of Hotel 54.

The 54 Barceloneta is just 3 minutes’ walk from Barceloneta Beach. You can walk to the attractive Born district in 10 minutes, and Barceloneta Metro Station is a 7-minute walk away.

Hotel Turin Barcelona is located just 50 meters from the famous Ramblas in Barcelona. It offers free Wi-Fi, 24-hour reception, free luggage storage and a lovely sun terrace. There is free water, coffee and tea in the lobby lounge.

It features stylish rooms with wooden floors and furnishings. They are equipped with a private bathroom, hairdryer, safe, Smart TV and minibar.

The Turin Hotel is located just 150 meters from the Gothic District, 3 minutes from the Liceu metro and a 20-minute walk from the beach. In the area there are several restaurants, shops and supermarkets open until late.

The hotel offers a fabulous breakfast buffet. Most of the food items come from La Boquería Market, located 2 minutes' walk away.

The H La Paloma Boutique is located in the Raval neighborhood, just 200 meters from the Sant Antoni market.
 The rooms at H La Paloma Boutique feature modern and elegant decoration.
They feature a king-size bed, free Wi-Fi, Smart TV and a private bathroom with a hairdryer and free toiletries. It also has private parking and 24-hour room service.
The H La Paloma Boutique has the ideal location to visit the major centers of interest on foot, being 600 meters from the MACBA Museum of Modern Art and just a 5-minute walk from Paseo de Gracia, Plaza de Catalunya and Las Ramblas.
The Sant Antoni and Universidad metro stations are just a few meters away.

hotel_name: Via Sants Hotel Barcelona, Tapestry Collection By Hilton
description:
Located in Barcelona, 500 metres from Sants Railway Station, Via Sants Hotel Barcelona, Tapestry Collection By Hilton provides accommodation with a garden, private parking, a shared lounge and a terrace. Featuring a bar, the 4-star hotel has air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi. The accommodation offers room service and a concierge service for guests.

All units at the hotel are equipped with a flat-screen TV with cable channels and a safety deposit box. Guest rooms will provide guests with a minibar.

A buffet breakfast is available daily at Via Sants Hotel Barcelona, Tapestry Collection By Hilton. At the accommodation you will find a restaurant serving American, Mediterranean and Spanish cuisine. Vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options can also be requested.

With staff speaking Catalan, English, Spanish and French, guidance is available at the reception.

Magic Fountain of Montjuic is 1.5 km from Via Sants Hotel Barcelona, Tapestry Collection By Hilton, while Passeig de Gracia is 2.9 km away. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 11 km from the property.

Stay in the refined elegance of the classic Hotel Continental Palacete, set in a renovated, 19th-century palace. Located right in the heart of Barcelona it is just 350 metres from Plaza Catalunya.

Guests have access to a free, 24-hour continental buffet with a variety of food and drinks.

Continental Palacete features luxurious, Baroque decor, with priceless chandeliers and elaborate frescoes.

Modern, air-conditioned rooms have free high-speed WiFi access, satellite TV, a fridge and a microwave. Their private bathrooms come with a hairdryer.

The hotel lies on the elegant Rambla de Catalunya, just a 5-minute walk from the city’s main square of Plaça Catalunya. The surrounding streets are full of Barcelona’s distinctive architecture, smart restaurants and exclusive boutiques.

Set 50 metres from the Ramblas, in the Raval district, Dalia Ramblas features air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi. Well served by public transport, it offers 24-hour reception and free luggage storage.

Featuring a modern and functional décor, rooms come with a flat-screen TV, wardrobe and a desk. All have a private bathroom with bath or shower. Free toiletries and hairdryer are provided.

Dalia Ramblas is set in the lively city centre. There are plenty of bars and restaurants in the surrounding area.

Next to the Gothic Quarter, Dalia Ramblas is 10 minutes’ walk from Plaza Catalunya and from Barcelona Cathedral. You can also reach the bustling Plaza Reial Square in a 5-minute walk.

Barcelona Airport is 12 km away from the hotel. Regular airport buses leave from a bus stop located just 800 metres away.

Feelathome Mozart Apartments offers air-conditioned apartments located 5 minutes' walk from Barcelona's Diagonal Metro Station. Free WiFi is available and some apartments have a private terrace.

Each apartment features a seating area with a flat-screen TV and DVD player. There is a well-equipped kitchen, which includes a dishwasher and washing machine, and the private bathroom comes with a shower and hairdryer. Towels and bed linen are provided.

An airport shuttle service is available for an extra charge. Plaza Catalunya and La Rambla are a pleasant 20-minute stroll down the famous Passeig de Gracia Avenue, with its iconic buildings like La Pedrera and Casa Batlló.

The stylish Hotel Jazz is located 2 minutes’ walk from Plaza Catalunya in the centre of Barcelona. It features a rooftop pool and terrace with views over the city.

The contemporary rooms include free Wi-Fi and a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. The modern bathroom comes with a hairdryer and amenities.

A breakfast buffet is served in the modern bar-café area of Hotel Jazz. This includes fresh fruit, pastries, and baked goods.

Universitat Metro Station is less than 100 metres from the hotel. The MACBA and CCCB galleries are within a 5-minute walk while the Gothic Quarter is 10 minutes away.

hotel_name: Radisson Blu 1882 Hotel, Barcelona Sagrada Familia
description:
Set in Barcelona, 400 metres from Sagrada Familia, Radisson Blu 1882 Hotel, Barcelona Sagrada Familia has an outdoor pool and a fitness centre. The 4-star hotel has air-conditioned rooms with a private bathroom and free WiFi.

At the hotel, each room comes with a desk. The rooms are fitted with a flat-screen TV, and certain rooms include a city view. All rooms feature a wardrobe.

A continental breakfast is served every morning at the property.

Radisson Blu 1882 Hotel, Barcelona Sagrada Familia offers a terrace with views of Sagrada Familia.

Staff are ready to help around the clock.

La Pedrera is a 14-minute walk from the accommodation. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 14 km from Radisson Blu 1882 Hotel, Barcelona Sagrada Familia.

A 5-minute walk from Plaza de Catalunya and Las Ramblas, H10 Urquinaona Plaza features a roof terrace with a small seasonal pool. It is set next to Urquinaona Metro Station.

H10 Urquinaona Plaza is set in a restored 19th-century building and features smart, contemporary décor. The chic rooms have minimalist design, free Wi-Fi, a Nespresso coffee maker, air conditioning and a flat-screen TV.

This H10 also features a restaurant, a bar and a lounge with a library. You can enjoy great city views from the roof terrace.

The Palau de la Música Catalana is a short walk away and the charming Born district is within 1 km of the hotel. The airport bus stop and Catalunya Metro and Railway Station are less than 5 minutes’ walk away.

Located next to Fabra i Puig Station, Ibis Barcelona Meridiana is a 10-minute Metro journey from Plaza Catalunya. It offers a 24-hour bar and air-conditioned rooms with flat-screen satellite TV.

Barcelona Meridiana’s bar serves a wide range of snacks and drinks.

Hotel Ibis Barcelona Meridiana is set next to the Heron City Shopping Centre, where you can find restaurants, cinemas and a gym. Indoor public parking is available at an extra cost.

hotel_name: La Casa de Antonio Boutique Rooms
description:
Featuring free WiFi, La Casa de Antonio Boutique Rooms is located in Barcelona. This guest house is set a 7-minute walk from Plaza Catalunya and 94 metres from Universitat Metro Station.

This guest house has a Modernist décor and offers air-conditioned rooms in the centre of Barcelona. Each room comes with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels and tiled floors, and the private bathroom includes a bath or shower, hairdryer, and free toiletries.

There is a tour desk available to all guests, and the property can arrange a shuttle to the airport for an extra charge.

You can find several restaurants, bars, and a grocery shop within a 5-minute walk of La Casa de Antonio Boutique Rooms. Plaza Espanya and the famous Montjuic Fountain are 2 metro stops from the property, and Gaudi’s Sagrada Familia is 2.7 km away.

Located just 2 blocks from the Sagrada Familia, this hotel has a rooftop terrace overlooking Gaudí’s world-famous temple. It offers 24-hour reception and rooms with satellite TV and free Wi-Fi.

The air-conditioned rooms at the Hotel Sagrada Familia feature parquet floors and modern furniture. They are equipped with a minibar and the private bathrooms come with a hairdryer.

Glòries Shopping Centre and Arc de Triomf are under 20 minutes’ walk from the hotel. Sagrada Familia Metro Station, located a 3-minute walk away, connects you with the city centre in 5 minutes.

Featuring a charming garden terrace, Praktik Garden is located 400 metres from Barcelona’s fashionable Passeig de Gracia Boulevard. Fully reburbished in 2015, its chic rooms feature colourful mosaic floors, a flat-screen TV and free WiFi.

Girona Metro Station is just around the corner from the hotel. From there guests can reach the city’s Barceloneta Beach in 15 minutes. Plaça Catalunya is 10 minutes’ walk from the hotel.

All rooms at the Praktik Garden are equipped with air conditioning and some rooms have balconies. The modern bathroom includes a shower.

Guests can relax in the hotel lounge or on the furnished garden terrace. The hotel provides vending machines for drinks 24-hours a day.

This modern hotel offers spacious, air-conditioned suites with a separate seating area, private balcony, free WiFi and 2 TVs. The hotel is 10 minutes’ walk from Barcelona’s Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard.

There are several restaurants within a 5-minute walk from Guitard Grand Passage. Also, the hotel is only 500 metres from Hospital Clinic Metro Station.

There are good transport connections to Barcelona El Prat Airport from Passeig de Gràcia Metro Station, located around 15 minutes’ walk away.

08028 Apartments are situated next to Les Corts Metro Station and 5 minutes’ walk from Barcelona’s Camp Nou Football Stadium. The modern apartments share a rooftop pool with views of Barcelona.

Apartments and suites at the 08028 feature contemporary design and free Wi-Fi. Apartments include a balcony, lounge area and a fitted kitchen.

The Taberna Lizarran at the 08028 Apartments serves traditional Spanish cuisine, including tapas.

The 08028 Apartments are a 15-minute walk from Sants Train Station. Plaza Catalunya and the famous Las Ramblas can be reached in around 20 minutes, by Metro.

Hotel Condes Barcelona occupies a 19th-century building on Passeig de Gracia with a seasonal rooftop pool and terrace. It features a gym and a sauna.

The soundproofed rooms at Condes de Barcelona Hotel are air conditioned, LCD satellite TV and laptop safe. They have views of Passeig de Gracia or a pretty Eixample courtyard, and some rooms include a small balcony.

The hotel has an elegant rooftop bar, Alaire Terrace Bar with wonderful views.

The Condes is just 100 metres from Gaudi’s La Pedrera, and a 10-minute walk from Plaça Catalunya and La Rambla. Passeig de Gracia Train Station, 200 metres away, offers direct links to Barcelona Airport.

hotel_name: AC Hotel Diagonal L'Illa by Marriott
description:
AC Hotel Diagonal L´Illa offers accommodation in Barcelona, 1.8 km from Camp Nou. Guests can enjoy the on-site restaurants,  paid parking located at commercial center.

Free WiFi is available throughout the hotel.

Every room at this hotel has plush bedding, a flat-screen TV and a spacious work desk. Every room includes a private bathroom equipped with a shower and free toiletries.

You will find a 24-hour front desk at the property. Surrounded by lush gardens, the property is near many upscale boutiques and restaurants.

The Suite Bar is a modern, welcoming space on the hotel’s second floor. Its contemporary décor and lighting make it an ideal spot to enjoy a drink.

The Picasso Museum is 3.8 km from AC Hotel Diagonal L´Illa, while La Pedrera is 2.2 km from the property. The nearest airport is El Prat Airport, 11 km away.

Set in a listed 19th-century building and 5 minutes’ walk from Gaudí’s Casa Batlló, the St. Moritz offers stylish accommodation. It features modern, air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi and LCD satellite TV.

The Hotel HCC St. Moritz maintains its original central staircase and marble reception. Its rooms offer simple, classic décor with a minibar and a private bathroom with a hairdryer, slippers and toiletries.

A varied buffet breakfast is served daily, and you can enjoy a range of Mediterranean dishes for dinner in the St Gallen Restaurant, where menus use fresh, seasonal produce.

Passeig de Gràcia and its Metro Station are just 5 minutes’ walk from the hotel, and Plaza de Catalunya and Las Ramblas are one stop away. Barcelona Port is just over 1 km from the St. Moritz.

Well set in Barcelona, Hotel Raval House provides air-conditioned rooms, a seasonal outdoor swimming pool, free WiFi and a garden. 2.5 km from Sant Sebastian Beach and 2.5 km from Sant Miquel Beach, the property offers a terrace and a bar. The property is non-smoking and is located 2.7 km from Barceloneta Beach.

At the hotel, every room comes with a wardrobe. With a private bathroom equipped with a shower and a hairdryer, certain units at Hotel Raval House also provide guests with a city view. All units at the accommodation are equipped with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels and a safety deposit box.

Speaking Catalan, English, Spanish and French at the 24-hour front desk, staff are willing to help at any time of the day.

Popular points of interest near Hotel Raval House include Boqueria Market, Plaça Catalunya and Portal de l'Angel. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 12 km from the hotel.

Situated in Barcelona, 400 metres from Sants Railway Station, Nobu Hotel Barcelona features accommodation with an outdoor swimming pool, private parking, a fitness centre and a terrace. Among the facilities of this property are a restaurant, room service and a 24-hour front desk, along with free WiFi throughout the property. The accommodation offers a concierge service, luggage storage space and currency exchange for guests.

The rooms at the hotel have air conditioning and a safety deposit box.

Nobu Hotel Barcelona offers a buffet or continental breakfast.

Magic Fountain of Montjuic is 1.4 km from the accommodation, while Casa Batllo is 2.7 km from the property. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 11 km away.

Super Balmes Guest House is located in Barcelona city center, 2 minutes' walk from Plaza Catalunya Square. Free Wi-Fi access is available.

The Guest House offers private rooms in shared apartments located in different building of the same central area.

They all come with a flat-screen TV and have a shared or private bathroom. Bed linen and towels are included. All apartments have a fully equipped kitchen for guests’ use and a shared lounge with sofas.

There are plenty of bars and restaurants within walking distances. Regular airport buses leave from a bus stop located within 10-minute walk.

The pictures at the top of this page are a selection of the different rooms and apartments located in the Barcelona City Center area. Please select a date and click on the room type to see the pictures of the individual apartments.

Set between the 2 main squares at the centre of Barcelona – Catalunya and Universitat – this small, modern hotel is ideally located for exploring the city’s cultural heart.

Chic & Basic Lemon is just off the top of the vibrant La Rambla and a short walk from the Gothic Quarter. It is only 100 metres from Plaça Catalunya and the start of the elegant boulevard of Passeig de Gràcia – site of Modernist marvels such as Casa Batlló.

Here you can take advantage of the great family service offered in this small property.

After seeing the sights, spend a restful night’s sleep in your own spacious bedroom. In it you will find amenities such as a digital TV, free safe and en suite bathroom with full bathtub. In addition, climate control allows you to stay in comfort all year round.

Located 7 minutes’ walk from Plaza Catalunya, Hotel Constanza has a fantastic rooftop terrace (open from May to October) with views over Barcelona. It offers a 24-hour reception and rooms with smart décor and satellite TV.

Staff at the Constanza Hotel’s 24-hour reception can help booking tickets for guided tours, live shows and other events. You can also hire a bicycle or car from reception.

The Constanza is 7 minutes’ walk from the Gothic Quarter, where you can find the Palau de la Música Catalana, a spectacular Modernist auditorium. Casa Batllo & la Pedrera are at 10-12 minutes walking distance form the Hotel. Urquinaona Metro Station & Plaza Catalunya Metro station are under 5 minutes’ walk away, connecting you with the rest of the city.

Set within 2.9 km of Passeig de Gracia and 3 km of La Pedrera in Barcelona, Isabella's House offers accommodation with seating area. Among the facilities of this property are a restaurant, a 24-hour front desk and a lift, along with free WiFi throughout the property. The aparthotel features family rooms.

The aparthotel will provide guests with air-conditioned units with a wardrobe, a coffee machine, a microwave, a toaster, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a a bath or shower. There is also a dining area and a fully equipped kitchen equipped with a fridge, a stovetop, and kitchenware. At the aparthotel, the units are equipped with bed linen and towels.

Guests at the aparthotel can enjoy a continental breakfast, and breakfast in the room is also available. A bar can be found on-site.

Sightseeing tours are available in the neighbourhood.

Camp Nou is 3.1 km from Isabella's House, while Casa Batllo is 3.2 km away. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 13 km from the property.

Set just 500 metres from Plaza Espanya, Home to Home Barcelona offers modern, air-conditioned apartments with free Wi-Fi. There is a shared terrace with a chill out zone and views of Montjuic.

Decorated in a minimalistic style, each apartment includes a living-dining area with a sofa bed and flat-screen satellite TV. Their kitchens are equipped with a microwave, electric hob, dishwasher and washer-dryer.

A wide range of shops, restaurants and bars can be found in the area. Arenas Shopping Centre is a 10-minute walk from the apartments and offers great views of the city from its rooftop.

Fira de Barcelona Convention Centre can also be reached in 10 minutes’ walk. Espanya Metro Station is 500 metres away and connects with Plaza Catalunya. Airport buses also stop in Plaza Espanya.

In a prime location in the Sants-Montjuïc district of Barcelona, Casa Vaganto is located 1.6 km from Magic Fountain of Montjuic, 1.6 km from Plaça Catalunya and 1.8 km from Santa Maria del Mar. This 3-star hotel offers a concierge service, luggage storage space and free WiFi. The property is allergy-free and is set 2.9 km from Sant Miquel Beach.

The hotel will provide guests with air-conditioned rooms with a wardrobe, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a shower.

Popular points of interest near Casa Vaganto include Portal de l'Angel, Passeig de Gracia and Boqueria Market. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 11 km away.

Set in Barcelona in the Catalonia Region, 200 metres from Plaza Reial, May Ramblas Hotel boasts a sun terrace and views of the city. Free WiFi is available throughout the property.

Every room at this hotel is air conditioned and features a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. A terrace or balcony are featured in certain rooms. All rooms have a private bathroom with free toiletries and a hairdryer.

There is a 24-hour front desk at the property.

La Seu, Cathedral of Barcelona is 400 metres from May Ramblas Hotel, while Portal de l'Angel is 500 metres away. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 12 km from the property.

Featuring free WiFi throughout the property, Serennia Exclusive Rooms offers accommodation in Barcelona, 400 metres from Plaça Catalunya.

Every room is fitted with a flat-screen TV. Certain rooms feature a seating area for your convenience. Each room is fitted with a private bathroom equipped with a bath. For your comfort, you will find free toiletries and a hair dryer.

You will find a shared lounge at the property.

Portal de l'Angel is 600 metres from Serennia Exclusive Rooms, while La Seu, Cathedral of Barcelona is 900 metres away. The nearest airport is El Prat Airport, 12 km from Serennia Exclusive Rooms.

Located 600 metres from Plaza Reial in Barcelona, Niu Barcelona Hotel features an outdoor pool on the rooftop. Free WiFi is offered throughout the property

Every room at this hotel comes with a flat-screen TV; while the private bathrooms come with shower and hairdryer. Rooms are air-conditioned in summer and heated in winter.

There is a 24-hour front desk at the property. Guests benefit from a complimentary bottle of water upon arrival.

Portal de l'Angel is 800 metres from Niu Barcelona Hotel, while Plaça Catalunya is 900 metres from the property. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 12 km from Niu Barcelona Hotel.

Featuring air conditioning, Habitat Apartments Cool Jazz is set in Barcelona, 1.1 km from Sagrada Familia. Park Güell is 2.1 km away.

The accommodation is fitted with a flat-screen TV. There is also a kitchenette, fitted with an oven and microwave. A toaster and refrigerator are also offered, as well as a coffee machine and a kettle. There is a private bathroom with a shower and a hair dryer in each unit. Towels are featured.

La Pedrera is 2.2 km from Habitat Apartments Cool Jazz, while Plaça Catalunya is 2.8 km from the property. The nearest airport is El Prat Airport, 15 km from the property.

Modern Apartments Center Exiample is set in the Eixample district of Barcelona, 1.1 km from Passeig de Gracia Metro Station, 1.1 km from Casa Batllo and 1.3 km from Tivoli Theatre. The property is located 1.4 km from Portal de l'Angel, 1.4 km from Boqueria Market and 1.7 km from Palau de la Musica Catalana. Cathedral of Barcelona is 1.7 km from the apartment.

The air-conditioned units have a fully equipped kitchen with a toaster and a fridge. Units are equipped with a coffee machine, a private bathroom and free WiFi, while selected rooms also offer a balcony and some have quiet street views. At the apartment complex, all units include bed linen and towels.

Popular points of interest near the apartment include Passeig de Gracia, Plaça Catalunya and La Pedrera. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 12 km from the property.

Cosmo Apartments Passeig de Gràcia is located in central Barcelona, 50 metres from the well-know Passeig de Gràcia Avenue. Casa Batlló and La Pedrera Modernist buildings are 5 minutes’ walk away.

The stylish and bright apartments at Cosmo Apartments Passeig de Gràcia can have 1 to 3 bedrooms, and duplex apartments with terrace are also available.

Featuring modern décor, all air-conditioned apartments are equipped with an open-plan kitchen with ceramic hob, microwave, dishwasher and kitchenware. There is also a living room with a 32-inch flat-screen TV and sofa bed.

Cosmo Apartments Passeig de Gràcia is well communicated to the city’s main tourist places, having the metro station 300 metres away.  Passeig de Gràcia is known for being the most important shopping street in Barcelona. Airport buses leave from Plaza Catalunya, located just 10 minutes' walk away.

BYPILLOW Ramblas is a modern guest house conveniently located in the famous Ramblas in Barcelona, 15 minutes’ walk from Plaza Catalunya and the port.

The Wax Museum and the airport bus stop are next to this guest house. The nearest metro station is Drassanes, located only 100 metres away. There is a wide range of monuments, bars and shops within walking distance.

The air-conditioned rooms at BYPILLOW Ramblas come with a TV and private bathroom with shower.

The multilingual staff will be happy to provide tourist information and free local maps. Free WiFi and luggage storage are also offered.

Fully renovated on february 2024

Featuring an outdoor swimming pool and hot tub on its terrace, Sunotel Club Central is set in Barcelona’s elegant Eixample neighbourhood.

Each modern air-conditioned room has free, high-speed WiFi, a TV and a minibar. The private bathroom includes a bath, shower and hairdryer.

Sunotel Club Central features a cosy bar, serving snacks and drinks. There is also room service available. The hotel has a 24-hour reception, and free bicycles are available upon request and subject to availability.

Passeig de Gracia, with its Gaudi monuments and designer shops, is a 10-minute walk from Sunotel Club Central. The famous Las Ramblas Boulevard and Plaza Catalunya are a 15-minute walk from the hotel. Barcelona Airport is 15 km away, and you can catch an airport bus in Plaza Catalunya.

In the Eixample district of Barcelona, close to Sagrada Familia, Suite Place Barcelona Còrsega features a terrace and a washing machine. Among the facilities at this property are a 24-hour front desk and a lift, along with free WiFi throughout the property. Private parking can be arranged at an extra charge.

Some of the units feature a satellite flat-screen TV, a fully equipped kitchen with a dishwasher, and a private bathroom with a bath and a hair dryer. At the apartment complex, some units are allergy-free.

A minimarket is available at the apartment.

Sightseeing tours are available close by.

La Pedrera is 1.7 km from the apartment, while Passeig de Gracia is 1.7 km away. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 15 km from Suite Place Barcelona Còrsega.

Aparthotel Napols is centrally located, 350 metres from Barcelona’s Arc de Triomf Metro Station. Air-conditioned rooms feature a well-equipped kitchen, and a living room with sofa and TV.

Estació de Nord Bus Station is 5 minutes’ walk away, and has direct connections to Girona Airport. You can walk to Plaza Catalunya and the Rambla in 15 minutes. There is free WiFi in the apartments.

Soundproofed rooms at the Napols have a safe and minibar. The private bathroom comes with amenities.

The modern kitchen has a fridge, microwave and coffee maker. There is a dishwasher and dining area.

The complex has a 24-hour reception and a shared terrace. You can hire a car, and Napols offers a laundry service and luggage storage.

hotel_name: Jardinets De Gràcia by The 5ve Soul
description:
Featuring quiet street views, Jardinets De Gràcia by The 5ve Soul is located in the Gràcia district of Barcelona, less than 1 km from La Pedrera and a 15-minute walk from Casa Batllo. It is situated 400 metres from Passeig de Gracia and features a lift. Rooms are equipped with a terrace with city views and free WiFi.

All units in the apartment complex are fitted with air conditioning, a seating area, a flat-screen TV with streaming services, a kitchen, a dining area, a safety deposit box and a private bathroom with a shower, slippers and a hair dryer. An oven, a microwave and toaster are also available, as well as a coffee machine and a kettle. At the apartment complex, each unit has bed linen and towels.

For guests with children, the apartment provides a baby safety gate.

Passeig de Gracia Metro Station is 1.6 km from Jardinets De Gràcia by The 5ve Soul, while Tivoli Theatre is 1.9 km from the property. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 14 km away.

Aparthotel Bertrán is located in a quiet part of Barcelona, 5 minutes’ walk from Avinguda Tibidabo FGC Station and Vallcarca Metro. It offers spacious accommodation, a gym and an outdoor pool.

Each air-conditioned Bertrán apartment has a living room with satellite TV and a sofa. The private bathroom comes with a hairdryer, and there is a kitchenette with a fridge, microwave and coffee maker.

Some apartments have a private balcony with table and chairs. All apartments have free Wi-Fi.

A continental breakfast is available at the Bertrán, and you can have breakfast in your apartment. There is a supermarket 2 minutes’ walk away.

There is a 24-hour reception, and you can hire a car from the tour desk. On-site parking is available for an extra charge.

You can reach Barcelona city centre in 15 minutes by train, Metro or bus, and there is a night bus stop nearby. Parc Güell is just over 1 km away.

Sweett - Palau offers accommodation within 1.4 km of the centre of Barcelona, with free WiFi, and a kitchen with a dishwasher, an oven and a microwave. The property is around 1.1 km from Passeig de Gracia Metro Station, 1.3 km from Tivoli Theatre and 1.8 km from Palau de la Musica Catalana. Cathedral of Barcelona is 1.9 km from the apartment and Plaça Catalunya is 1.6 km away.

All units come with a toaster, fridge, a coffee machine, a stovetop and kettle. Complete with a private bathroom equipped with a shower and a hair dryer, the units at the apartment complex have a flat-screen TV and air conditioning, and selected rooms will provide you with a terrace. At the apartment complex, the units are fitted with bed linen and towels.

Popular points of interest near the apartment include La Pedrera, Passeig de Gracia and Casa Batllo. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 14 km away.

Fisa Rentals Gran Via Apartments are stylish apartments set 5 minutes’ walk from Plaza de Catalunya and Las Ramblas. They have free Wi-Fi access and a flat-screen TV.

Each spacious Fisa Rentals apartment offers contemporary décor and chic wooden floors. All apartments are air conditioned, but there is one bedroom that doesn't have air conditioning. All the apartments have a spacious seating area with satellite TV. The well-equipped kitchens also have a washing machine.

The apartments have easy access to the centre of Barcelona and are within 10 minutes’ walk of a selection of shops, bars and restaurants.

Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard is 300 metres away and Gaudí’s Casa Batlló and La Pedrera can be reached in 15 minutes, by foot. Passeig de Gràcia and Urquinaona Metro Stations are around 200 metres away.

Quartprimera Apartments  is located just 80 metres from the emblematic Passeig de Gracia. It offers bright, air-conditioned apartments with flat-screen TV and free WiFi and private bathroom.

Set in a reformed, century-old building, apartments at Quartprimera feature elegant modern décor and have terraces, balconies or views to Gaudi´s La Pedrera, 2 minutes' walk away.

Bohemian Gracia is 5 minutes’ walk away and the Sagrada Familia and Plaza Catalunya are both 15 minutes’ walk away. Quartprimera is located 2 minutes’ walk from Diagonal Metro station.

Featuring free Wi-Fi and air conditioning, Apartamentos DV is located in Barcelona, 800 metres from Camp Nou. Palau Sant Jordi is 2.8 km from the property. Private parking is available for a fee.

Offering views over a patio, each apartment comes with a flat-screen TV and a fully equipped kitchen including a microwave, kettle and kitchenware. Apartments come with a bathroom with a double ended bath and hairdryer is available on prior request. Apartments are cleaned every day and bed linen and towels are provided. Superior apartments have a spa bath.

Plenty of restaurants, bars and shops are within 5 minutes' walk.

Montjuïc is 2.9 km from Apartamentos DV, while Casa Batllo is 3.9 km away. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 9 km from the property.

Lempika is a self-catering accommodation located in Barcelona, just 5 minutes' walk from Plaza Espanya. These stylish apartments have free WiFi, a flat-screen TV and DVD player.

The apartments have retro-style décor, with parquet floors and white furnishings. Each one has a well-equipped kitchen, and some have a private balcony.

In 5 minutes you can walk to Les Arenes Shopping Centre, a converted bullring. There you'll also find Montjuïc Hill, home to the Joan Miró Museum and the Magic Fountain. By metro you can get to the Ramblas in just 5 minutes.

Sensation Authentic Gracia is a self-catering accommodation located in Barcelona. Free WiFi access is available in all apartments. The property is a 10-minute walk from Gaudi's La Sagrada Familia.

Accommodation will provide you with a TV and air conditioning. There is a full kitchenette with a dishwasher and a microwave. Featuring a bath, private bathrooms also come with a hairdryer and free toiletries. All properties include a private balcony with chairs and tables. Bed linen and towels are provided.

Joanic Metro Station is a 5-minute walk away, and you can reach Plaça Catalunya and the centre in 15 minutes by metro. You can reach Gaudi's La Pedrera in 20 minutes by metro, and Barcelona-El Prat Airport is located 16 km away.

The Barcelona City North Hostal offers value-for-money accommodation and free Wi-Fi. It is in the quiet Sarrià-Sant Gervasi area of Barcelona, with good access by car to the airport.

The rooms at the Barcelona City North are clean, heated and air conditioned. All come with a private bathroom, a TV and a kettle.

Guests at Barcelona City North Hostal have access to a common area with a microwave and fridge.

The hostel is within walking distance of the popular Gràcia neighbourhood and the Modernist buildings of the Eixample.

Nearby Lesseps Metro Station offers easy access to Vallcarca and the Parc Güell. Plaça Catalunya is only 3 stops away.

The Catalonia Catedral is set in a traditional Modernist building, just 100 metres from Barcelona Cathedral. It offers free use of Smartphones, Wi-Fi access, a rooftop seasonal pool and a Japanese-style terrace and garden.

The Catedral has stylish rooms, which have contemporary décor. Each has a flat-screen smart TV equipped with Chromecast app, air conditioning, a minibar, a Nespresso machine. A smartphone is available for guests during their stay free of charge.

The hotel’s Ascent Restaurant by Eboca serves Mediterrean cuisine and offers views of the nearby Palacio Pignatelli Art Gallery. There is also a bar in the hotel lobby where guests can use the computers with internet access and printers for free.

The Catalonia Catedral is around 10 minutes’ walk from landmarks such as Las Ramblas and Plaza de Catalunya Square. Barcelona’s Old Port and Marina are less than one kilometre away. Jaume I Metro Station is 5 minutes' walk away.

Plaza Goya Rooms is located in the centre of Barcelona and a few minutes’ walk from the Las Ramblas. It features free WiFi and free luggage storage.

Rooms at Plaza Goya Rooms are air conditioned and include a flat-screen TV and safe. The private bathroom comes with a hairdryer and free toiletries. Some rooms have a balcony.

You can find several restaurants, bars, and a grocery shop within a 5-minute walk of Plaza Goya Rooms. Universitat Metro Station is 50 metres away, and Gaudi’s Sagrada Familia is 4 metro stops away. Plaza Catalunya and Las Ramblas are 700 metres from the property.

Situated within 2.7 km of Sant Miquel Beach and 2.7 km of Barceloneta Beach, Stay U-nique Apartments Urquinaona features rooms with air conditioning and a private bathroom in Barcelona. It is set 600 metres from Palau de la Musica Catalana and offers a lift. The property is 2.6 km from Somorrostro Beach, and within 400 metres of the city centre.

Featuring a fully equipped kitchen with a dishwasher and an oven, each unit also comes with a cable flat-screen TV, ironing facilities, wardrobe and a seating area with a sofa. Featuring a private bathroom with a bidet and a hair dryer, units at the apartment complex also boast free WiFi, while certain rooms are fitted with a balcony. At the apartment complex, every unit comes with bed linen and towels.

Popular points of interest near the apartment include Passeig de Gracia, Tivoli Theatre and Passeig de Gracia Metro Station. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 13 km from Stay U-nique Apartments Urquinaona.

Miramar Barcelona has a picturesque setting within gardens on Montjuïc Mountain, overlooking the Mediterranean Sea. It offers 2 swimming pools, free Wi-Fi and rooms with spectacular views of Barcelona.

Housed in a former palace with a Neucentisme style, the hotel maintains many of the building’s original features and it is one of the symbols of the city. The interiors have chic, contemporary design.

Guests can make use of the on-site fitness centre, or relax by the seasonal outdoor swimming pool. The hotel's L´Occitane Spa features an indoor pool, hot tub, sauna, steam room, pressure showers and treatment cabins.

The hotel has 24-hour room service and a bar with a terrace. Studio Miramar restaurant serves a selection of Catalan and Mediterranean dishes.

Each of the Miramar’s air-conditioned rooms has floor to ceiling windows, a 47-inch TV with international channels and a minibar with a courtesy bottle of water. Their private bathrooms come with L'Occitane toiletries, hairdryer, bathrobes, slippers and either a shower or a designer bath tub.

The Joan Miró Foundation, the Old Port and the National Art Museum of Catalonia are within 20 minutes’ walk of the Miramar. And just 10 minutes walk from the Olympic Stadium and Palau Sant Jordi.

Hotel Brummell is a 20-room boutique hotel located a few steps from the Miró Foundation and The Grec theatre. Guests will benefit from free and unlimited yoga classes. A running club, for both guests and locals, is organized regularly.

The hotel features an outdoor pool, a garden and a sauna. T-training and boxing session are hosted at the well-being center The Loft.

All rooms boast modern furniture and artwork by young European designers. Each one is equipped with a safe, coffee and tea facilities and a yoga mat. The private bathroom has a rain shower, a high-powered hairdryer and free toiletries by MMLL. Suites have a private, furnished terrace with an outdoor bath.

FUNKY, Hotel Brummell’s new restaurant, offers a delightful eatery concept. An in-house bakery prepares a daily breakfast with a selection of oven-baked croissant and breads, local cheeses, olives, charcuteries, mató and honeycomb, Funky’s granola, whipped butter and house jam, seasonal fresh fruits and veggies, accompanied by a soft boiled egg. Pair your treats with their Nomad Filter Coffee, and experience the perfect harmony of flavors in a cozy, inviting atmosphere.

Hotel Brummell is just a 15-minute walk from La Rambla and the closest metro station is Parallel Metro Station, 250 m away.

For guests who wish to explore the sights of Barcelona, Montjuïc is known for its parks and gardens and is within 10 minutes' walk. There is free WiFi available throughout.

Situated in Barcelona in the Catalonia Region, 400 metres from Portal de l'Angel, Yurbban Passage Hotel boasts an outdoor pool and spa centre. Guests can enjoy the on-site restaurant.

All rooms include a flat-screen TV. Certain rooms feature a seating area to relax in after a busy day. A terrace or balcony are featured in certain rooms. Each room includes a private bathroom. Extras include bathrobes and slippers. Yurbban Passage Hotel features free WiFi throughout the property.

Guests can enjoy an authentic Catalan breakfast each morning.

You will find a 24-hour front desk at the property.

The hotel also offers bike hire. Plaça Catalunya is 500 metres from Yurbban Passage Hotel, while La Seu, Cathedral of Barcelona is 500 metres from the property. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 13 km away.

limehome Barcelona Rector Triadó is located just 300 metres from Sants Train Station, in a commercial district of Barcelona. This modern air-conditioned apartment complex offers spacious accommodation with free WiFi access.

The complex has stylish apartments, with minimalist design. They all offer an en-suite bathroom and well-equipped kitchen. Both the living area and bedroom have LCD TV with satellite channels. You can make use of a communal laundry room.

limehome Barcelona Rector Triadó are a short walk from the Fira Exhibition Centre. Montjuïc Hill is also nearby. Attractions include the Olympic stadium, the Catalan National Gallery and the Magic Fountain.

The apartments are well-placed for transport connections, only 3 stops from Camp Nou. Plaça Espanya Metro Station is 300 metres away. Direct airport buses also stop in the square.

Weflating Suites Sant Antoni Market is located in Barcelona, right next to Sant Antoni Market and 12 minutes' walk from the Ramblas. It offers modern, air-conditioned apartments with free WiFi.

The apartment will provide you with a balcony and a seating area. There is a full a kitchenette with a dishwasher and a microwave. Featuring a shower, private bathroom also comes with a hairdryer and free toiletries. You can enjoy city view from the apartments.

There are many great bars and restaurants in the streets around the apartments, such as Carrer Parlament or Carrer Blai. Apolo Nightclub is also 8 minutes' walk away.

Murmuri Residence Mercader is situated in the Eixample district in Barcelona. La Pedrera is 300 metres from the property. Free WiFi is featured throughout the property.

All units include a satellite flat-screen TV and iPod docking station. Some units have a terrace and/or balcony with city views. There is also a kitchen, fitted with a dishwasher. An oven is also provided, as well as a coffee machine and a kettle. There is a private bathroom with free toiletries and a hairdryer in each unit. Towels are offered.

If your apartment is not available upon arrival or you need to store your luggage on the day of departure, free individual lockers are available for you next to the elevators on the main floor. The hours of use are from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m.

Casa Batllo is 400 metres from Murmuri Residence Mercader, while Plaça Catalunya is 1 km away. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 13 km from the property.

Ideally situated in the Eixample district of Barcelona, One Shot Aragó is situated 500 metres from Passeig de Gracia, 500 metres from Passeig de Gracia Metro Station and less than 1 km from Plaça Catalunya. Featuring a shared lounge, the 3-star hotel has air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi, each with a private bathroom. The property is 100 metres from Casa Batllo, and within less than 1 km of the city centre.

At the hotel, each room includes a wardrobe. The rooms include a desk and a flat-screen TV, and some rooms at One Shot Aragó have a terrace. All rooms have a safety deposit box.

Speaking Catalan, English and Spanish at the reception, staff are ready to help around the clock.

Popular points of interest near the accommodation include La Pedrera, Boqueria Market and Tivoli Theatre. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 13 km from the property.

Boutique Hotel H10 Montcada has fantastic views of Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter and the sea from its roof terrace and hot tub. It offers modern rooms with free Wi-Fi.

The air-conditioned rooms at Boutique Hotel H10 Montcada feature parquet floors and natural light. Each one comes with a minibar, a free safe, and a flat-screen TV with international satellite channels.

The hotel’s stylish restaurant serves a daily buffet breakfast. There are also 2 bars, including the Sunset Bar located on the roof terrace. Room service is also available.

The attentive staff at the 24-hour reception can help booking tickets for guided tours, live shows and other events. Bicycle and car rental services can also be arranged.

Barcelona's main tourist attractions such as the Cathedral, the Ramblas and the Picasso Museum are within walking distance of the hotel.

Boutique Hotel H10 Montcada is just 3 minutes’ walk from the Palau de la Música Catalana, a spectacular Modernist auditorium and UNESCO World Heritage Site. Airport buses leave from Plaza Catalunya, 5 minutes’ walk away.

Situated in the charming Gràcia district, these elegant design apartments offer a balcony and a stylish kitchen with a ceramic hob, dishwasher and washing machine. Fontana Metro Station is just 200 metres away.

The air-conditioned Gran de Gracia apartments feature sleek contemporary décor. Each one has a lounge with a flat-screen TV and 2 sofa beds. The modern bathrooms include a shower.

A variety of supermarkets, cafés and restaurants can be found within a 5-minute walk of the Gran de Gracia apartments. The surrounding streets are full of quirky boutiques and lively bars.

Gaudí’s Casa Vicenç is just 150 metres from the apartments, while Parc Güell is a 20-minute walk away. You can walk to Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard in around 15 minutes.

Situated 100 metres from Fontana Metro Station in Barcelona's popular Gracia district, Aparthotel Silver offers a 24-hour reception, a bar and a garden terrace. Rooms include free Wi-Fi and a kitchenette.

Each air-conditioned room at Aparthotel Silver has simple, elegant décor. All rooms offer satellite TV, a laptop safe and a private bathroom with amenities. Kitchenettes include an electric oven, kettle and fridge.

You can enjoy a drink in the Silver’s bar, and room service is available on request. Staff at reception can also arrange car or bicycle rental and provide information about the city.

Silver Aparthotel is 200 metres from Casa Vicenç, a Gaudi building. Barcelona city centre is within a 10-minute Metro journey, while Parc Guell is just one Metro stop away.

Hotel HCC Regente is set in a traditional Modernist building which has been recently restored, maintaining its original features. HCC Regente is located on Rambla de Catalunya.

The Regente features Art Nouveau décor and wrought-iron balconies. Each air-conditioned room has satellite TV, free wired internet access and a minibar.

The hotel serves a varied breakfast in its restaurant. There is a wide range of cafés, bars and restaurants in the streets surrounding the HCC.

Attractions including Las Ramblas and Gaudí’s Casa Batlló are within 10 minutes’ walk of the Regente. Passeig de Gràcia Metro Station is just 200 metres from the hotel.

The stylish apartments at San Antoni Market are less than 5 minutes’ walk from Sant Antoni Metro station in central Barcelona. They offer smart accommodation with free Wi-Fi, just 200 metres from the market.

The spacious apartments at Sant Antoni Market combine modern décor with original features such as beamed ceilings or French doors. The living room has a sofa and a flat-screen TV, while the kitchen comes with a microwave, fridge, oven, a toaster and a coffee maker.

There is a range of shops, bakeries, bars and cafés in the streets surrounding the apartments. The famous Las Ramblas and Plaza de Catalunya are within 20 minutes’ walk.

The MACBA Museum is less than 1 km from the apartments. Sant Antoni Metro Station is just 5 stops from the Sagrada Família. The airport bus stops on Comte d’Urgell and at Plaza Universitat, both within 15 minutes’ walk.

Hotel Moderno has a central location, on a side street just 20 metres from Barcelona’s famous Las Ramblas. It offers free Wi-Fi access throughout.

All rooms at the Moderno are heated, air conditioned and soundproofed. There is also cable TV, a fridge and a private bathroom with toiletries.

The hotel is just a short walk from the Boquería Market on La Rambla. Plaza de Catalunya and the city’s cathedral are just a few minutes’ walk away.

The hotel’s City Tour offer is ideal for exploring the city. There is also a ticket service. The 3 computers in the lobby can be used for free.

The Moderno has a 24-hour front desk and offers express check-in and check-out.

Situated conveniently in the centre of Barcelona, Yurbban Ramblas Boutique Hotel offers air-conditioned rooms, a terrace, free WiFi and a restaurant.
