Popular points of interest nearby include Passeig de Gracia Metro Station, Tivoli Theatre and Passeig de Gracia. The property is non-smoking and is set 2.5 km from Sant Miquel Beach.

At the hotel, all rooms are fitted with a wardrobe, a TV, a private bathroom, bed linen and towels. Every room has a safety deposit box, while selected rooms will provide you with a balcony and others also have city views.

A buffet breakfast is available every morning at Yurbban Ramblas Boutique Hotel.

Speaking English, Spanish and French, staff are willing to help at the 24-hour front desk.

Popular points of interest near the accommodation include Boqueria Market, Plaça Catalunya and Portal de l'Angel. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 13 km away.

The recently renovated apartments are conveniently and centrally located in the cosmopolitan L’Eixample district, just 5 minutes from Paseo de Gracia, Rambla Cataluña and Plaza Cataluña. 

The apartments are contemporary and well-equipped and offer a great base for tourists looking for central and safe area for their stay. 

Close by you can visit Gaudi’s famous buildings situated along Paseo de Gracia and the Rambla, as well as enjoying a good selection of shops, boutiques, cafes, and lively bars and restaurants. The area is also very well-served by public transport links (metro, a number of bus routes and a Renfe train station), allowing hassle-free access to all of Barcelona’s places of interest.

Located 15 minutes' walk from Las Ramblas and Plaça Espanya, Hostal Barcelona has rooms with air conditioning, TV and free Wi-Fi. Famous for its theatres, Parallel Avenue is 100 metres away.

Hostal Barcelona can provide tourist information, assist with ticket reservations including the Barcelona Tourist Bus, and help arrange car/bike rental. There is an internet terminal in reception. A luggage storage service is available and all rooms have a safe. Reception is available 24 hours.

A continental breakfast buffet is served from 07:30 to 10:30 It offers different kinds of bread, butter, jams, cornflakes, yogurt, cheese, ham, salami, croissants, chocolate croissants, muffins, biscuits, gaufres, Nutella, fruit, juice, coffee, milk and tea. Cold and hot drinks and pastries are available 24 hours a day. Guests also have access to a microwave. There is a supermarket in the same building, restaurants and bars in the surroundings.

Parallel Metro Station and many bus routes are 100 metres from Hostal Barcelona. The Fira Convention Centre is 12 minutes away by public transport. Montjuïc is a 5-minute walk from the guest house, and the Old Harbour can be reached in 20 minutes on foot.

Set just 100 metres from La Rambla in central Barcelona, BYPILLOW Wander offers modern rooms with air conditioning and free WiFi. Drassanes Metro Station is just 50 metres away.

Located on the 4th floor, all rooms have a private bathroom with a hairdryer and shower. They are heated, air-conditioned and include a flat-screen TV.

You will find a wide range of shops, restaurants and bars in the area. Barcelona’s Port Vell is just 350 metres from BYPILLOW Wander and the Maritime Museum is 150 metres away.

Barcelona Beach can be reached in a 15-minute bus ride. Plaza Catalunya is a 15-minute walk from the property and buses to the airport leave from there.

The Petit Palace Boqueria Garden is set in a historic 19th-century building by La Boqueria Market, 10 meters from Las Ramblas, and offers free high-speed WiFi and free bicycle use (subject to availability).

Each room at the Petit Palace Boqueria Garden includes a flat-screen TV and laptop safe, and a private bathroom. The hotel also offers an electric scooter hire service, subject to availability.

The hotel's bar is set by a private courtyard and garden with hundred-year-old trees, a listed site of architectural heritage in Barcelona.

Petit Palace Boqueria Garden is located in Barcelona's Gothic Quarter, just a 1-minute walk from Liceu Metro Station, offering convenient transport around the city. Plaça Catalunya Square is 800 meters away, and you can walk to Barcelona Port in 8 minutes.

These modern, fully-equipped apartments with free Wi-Fi are located in a quiet neighbourhood near Montjuïc Hill and the lively Poble Sec neighbourhood. Barcelona’s ferry terminal is just 5 minutes’ drive away.

There are several bars, restaurants and shops within 5 minutes’ walk of the apartments. Mercat Sant Antoni Food Market is about 10 minute’s walk away.

The apartments are about 15 minutes’ walk from the city’s famous Ramblas. Parallel Metro Station is about 5 minutes’ walk away and services line 3, which will take visitors to Plaza Catalunya and Plaza Espanya.

Located in Barcelona, 900 metres from Port Olympic, ibis Styles Barcelona City Bogatell features private parking and free WiFi access. The hotel has an outdoor pool and children's playground, and guests can enjoy a drink at the bar.

A TV is available.

You will find a 24-hour front desk at the property.

You can play table tennis at the hotel. The hotel also offers bike hire. Picasso Museum is 1.5 km from ibis Styles Barcelona City Bogatell, while La Seu, Cathedral of Barcelona is 1.8 km from the property. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 15 km from ibis Styles Barcelona City Bogatell.

Overlooking Camp Nou Stadium and Diagonal Avenue, the modern NH Barcelona Stadium offers free WiFi, a gym and seasonal rooftop pool. The air-conditioned rooms have flat-screen satellite TV, minibar and a pillow menu.

NH Barcelona Stadium Hotel’s seasonal sun terrace offers wonderful views across Barcelona to Montjuic. It also has sun loungers.

The hotel’s restaurant, Acanto, offers a varied buffet breakfast, as well as an á la carte lunch menu. The lobby café is open until midnight every day. The restaurant is closed during summer months.

Les Corts Metro Station is just 5 minutes’ walk away and offers a direct link to Barcelona’s historic centre. Diagonal Avenue can be reached in 10 minutes on foot, and Sants Station is 1.5 km away.

Barcelona's Fira Congress Centre is a 10-minute drive from the hotel. Barcelona El Prat Airport can also be reached in 10 minutes by car.

Set on Avinguda Parallel, Lugano is 500 metres from Plaza España’s FIRA Exhibition Centre, and the nearby Metro and railway stations. It offers a 24-hour reception and free Wi-Fi.

Each air-conditioned room at Lugano has simple décor. There is a flat-screen TV, a minibar and a private bathroom with free toiletries.

Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast in the Lugano’s café-bar. Restaurants can be found in Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter and along Las Ramblas, 20 minutes’ walk away. Drassanes Metro Station, at the bottom of Las Ramblas, is also just 2 stops from Poble Sec Metro Station.

Rooms located on the main façade and with views over Avenida del Paralelo. It has two beds and an extra bed to accommodate a third person.

Montjuïc Park, the MNAC Museum and Pueblo Español Village are less than 1 km from the hotel. The city’s old port is just 2 km away.

MH Apartments Suites is located in Barcelona’s Eixample district, 500 metres from the prestigious Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard. It offers modern apartments with free Wi-Fi and international satellite TV.

The modern MH Suites feature smart décor and parquet floors. They all have a seating area with sofas, a flat-screen TV and DVD player.

The kitchens at MH Apartments feature an oven, hob and Nespresso coffee maker. There is also a washing machine.

Late check-out is available on request at MH Apartments Suites. There is 24-hour customer service, and check-in staff can provide information about what to see and do in Barcelona.

Gaudí’s La Pedrera and Casa Batlló are under 10 minutes’ walk from the apartments. Girona and Verdaguer Metro Stations are both a 5-minute walk away, connecting you with the rest of the city.

hotel_name: Nuevo apartamento zona Paseo de Gracia
description:
Situated in Barcelona, 200 metres from Passeig de Gracia and 600 metres from La Pedrera, Nuevo apartamento zona Paseo de Gracia offers free WiFi and air conditioning. Popular points of interest near the apartment include Passeig de Gracia Metro Station, Tivoli Theatre and Plaça Catalunya. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 14 km from the property.

hotel_name: Maravilloso alojamiento frente a la Casa Batlló
description:
Situated in Barcelona, a few steps from Passeig de Gracia and 300 metres from Passeig de Gracia Metro Station, Maravilloso alojamiento frente a la Casa Batlló offers air conditioning. The property is close to several well-known attractions, 1.1 km from Palau de la Musica Catalana, less than 1 km from Portal de l'Angel and a 15-minute walk from Cathedral of Barcelona. The property is 60 metres from Casa Batllo, and within 800 metres of the city centre.

Aparthotel Atenea Calabria is situated 200 metres from Rocafort Metro Station, a 10-minute walk from Plaza España Square. This aparthotel features spacious studios with free Wi-Fi, a well-equipped kitchenette and a flat-screen TV.

The Atenea’s studios are spacious and brightly decorated. Each has a seating area with satellite TV and sofa bed. The kitchenette comes with a fridge, microwave and coffee maker.

The Calabria offers a daily buffet breakfast. There are also a range of supermarkets, cafés and restaurants within walking distance of the aparthotel.

The Atenea Calabria is around a 20-minute walk from Sants Train and Bus Station. Plaza Catalunya and the Ramblas are 3 Metro stops away from nearby Rocafort Metro Station.

Featuring free WiFi,  Radas is set in Barcelona, 500 metres from Montjuïc. Palau Sant Jordi is 1.3 km away and Fira Barcelona is a 13-minute walk away.

The apartment features a seating-dining area with a satellite flat-screen TV, CD and DVD player. All units include a kitchen fitted with a dishwasher, electric kettle, ceramic hob and oven. A microwave, a toaster and refrigerator are also offered, as well as a coffee machine. Some apartments have a terrace, balcony or chill out area.

Radas offers two-bedroom and one-bedroom apartments. They are equipped with a private bathroom with a hairdryer. Bed linen and towels are provided. Each apartment has a climate control system.

Plaza Reial is 1.5 km from Radas, while Plaça Catalunya is 1.8 km from the property. The nearest airport is El Prat Airport, 11 km from Radas, which you can reach by public transport from a bus stop 500 metres from the property.

Featuring free WiFi, a restaurant and a seasonal outdoor pool, 1881 Barcelona Gran Rosellon Hotel offers accommodation in Barcelona, 5 minutes' walk from Diagonal Metro Station.

The hotel has a sun terrace and a fitness centre, and guests can enjoy a drink at the bar. There is also a 24-hour front desk at the property.

Air-conditioned rooms include a flat-screen TV and a telephone. Some have a seating area to relax in after a busy day. Every room includes a private bathroom with free toiletries.

La Pedrera is 600 metres from Bcn Urban Gran Rosellon, while the trendy Passeig de Gràcia Street is 8 minutes' walk away. Plaça Catalunya is 1.7 km from the property and Barcelona El Prat Airport is 13 km away. Private parking is available on site.

hotel_name: AC Hotel Victoria Suites by Marriott
description:
Beautiful and stylish suites located in the heart of Pedralbes, one of the top residential areas of Barcelona and close to one of the city's main business districts.

AC Hotel Victoria Suites is ideal for business travellers due its location, for weekend breaks due its tranquil environment and excellent gastronomy offer as well for families due the spaciousness of the rooms.

It features a large terrace-bar, a high quality restaurant, friendly staff and many other details.

Featuring free WiFi, Amra Barcelona Gran Via is located in Barcelona, within a 10-minute walk of Plaza Catalunya and Arc de Triomf. This guest house offers a shared terrace and garden.

Each air conditioned room at this guest house has a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, free safe, and work desk, plus a minibar and coffee machine. The private bathroom includes a bath or shower, hairdryer, and free toiletries.

The property also offers a ticket service and  parking for an extra charge. Guests can make use of our chill-out sun terrace.

You can find several restaurants, bars, and grocery shops within a 5-minute walk from Amra Barcelona Gran Vía. Plaza Catalunya is 750 metres from the property, and Gaudi's Sagrada Familia is just 2 metro stops away.

This hotel is set in the heart of the cosmopolitan city of Barcelona, just a short distance from Las Ramblas and within walking distance of attractions such as the Liceu opera house and Plaça Catalunya.

The Hotel Alba is located in Barcelona’s old town, and its beautiful façade is listed for its artistic interest. Inside, relax in a spacious en suite bedroom with balcony and air conditioning.

Stroll down the colourful Ramblas to the seafront, or enjoy cava and tapas in the famous Boqueria food market. Just a short walk away, the narrow streets of the Gothic Quarter are full of shops, bars and restaurants.

The Alba boasts convenient public transport links, with Liceu metro station only 300 metres away. From here you can travel quickly and conveniently to attractions including the Fira de Barcelona and Gaudi’s incredible Parc Güell.

NH Barcelona Entenza is 10 minutes’ walk from Barcelona Sants Station and high-speed AVE Station. La Fira Exhibition Centre is 1.5 km away. All air-conditioned rooms are spacious, soundproofed and offer free Wi-Fi.

Rooms in the NH Barcelona Entenza Hotel are bright and modern with wooden floors. They feature satellite TV, minibar and a fully equipped bathroom with hairdryer.

A buffet breakfast is served in the hotel and breakfast in the room is available. One of Barcelona’s main streets, Diagonal Avenue, is a 10-minute walk from the hotel, with many restaurants and shops.

The NH Barcelona Entenza is in a quiet area but is well-connected to the city centre by Metro. Entença Metro Station is 200 metres away. FC Barcelona's Camp Nou Stadium is 3 stops away by Metro.

Located in central Barcelona, Hostal Balkonis guest house offers a terrace, free Wi-Fi throughout. Sant Antoni Metro Station is just 80 metres away.

This property offers functional and modern rooms with a private bathroom with a hairdryer and free toiletries each. They all feature heating, air conditioning, flat-screen TV and a radio. Some have a balcony with garden and city views.

You can hire bicycles on site, allowing you to explore more of the city.

You will find bars and restaurants in the surrounding streets and the closest supermarket is just 30 metres away.

A 12-minute walk will take you to Barcelona’s La Rambla and Barceloneta Beach is 3 km away. Plaza de España, with direct buses to Barcelona Airport is 20 minutes’ walk from Hostal Balkonis.

Good-Home Paseo de Gracia is located in Barcelona. Free WiFi access is available. Each room here will provide you with a TV, air conditioning and a balcony or terrace.

All air-conditioned rooms have a flat-screen TV, safe, and seating area. The private bathroom includes a shower and hairdryer.

This bed and breakfast offers a simple self-service breakfast, including toasts, pastries, and cereals. Complete with a microwave, the dining area also has a refrigerator and an electric kettle. There is a coffee and tea machine, available from 8:00 to 12:00. Other facilities offered at the property include a tour desk.

The bed and breakfast is 200 metres from Diagonal, 200 metres from La Pedrera and 1 km from Passeig de Gracia Station. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 13 km away.

hotel_name: Blasco de Garay Apartment - Poble Sec
description:
Situated in Barcelona, 1.2 km from Magic Fountain of Montjuic and 1.8 km from Plaça Catalunya, Blasco de Garay Apartment - Poble Sec features air-conditioned accommodation with a balcony and free WiFi. It is located 3.2 km from Tivoli Theatre and offers a lift. The property is non-smoking and is set 1.8 km from Portal de l'Angel.

This apartment has 2 bedrooms, a kitchen with a dishwasher and an oven, a TV, a seating area and 1 bathroom. For added privacy, the accommodation features a private entrance.

Popular points of interest near the apartment include Palau Sant Jordi, Passeig de Gracia and Boqueria Market. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 12 km from Blasco de Garay Apartment - Poble Sec.

Offering a central location, Barcelona Century Hotel is located in the Eixample district, just a short walk from the Ramblas and Passeig de Gracia. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout.

All air-conditioned rooms at this hotel are soundproofed and come with satellite TV, safe, minibar and a private bathroom with hairdryer.

The hotel offers buffet breakfast as well as a bar. Staff at the 24-hour front desk can provide tourist information about the area.

Barcelona’s main shopping district can be reach within walking distance of the hotel. You can visit Barcelona’s Cathedral or the Gothic Quarter.

Urgell, Hospital Clínic or Universitat Metro Stations are less than 7 minutes’ walk of Barcelona Century Hotel.

Located 300 metres from Barcelona’s Nova Icaria Beach, Hotel SB Icaria offers a gym, sauna and outdoor pool with sun terrace and hot tub. Rooms include free Wi-Fi and flat-screen satellite TV.

The Hotel SB Icaria’s stylish modern rooms feature wooden floors and adjustable lighting. Each room has a minibar, safe and private bathroom with a hairdryer.

The hotel’s elegant restaurant serves Mediterranean market cuisine. There is also a bar and a garden terrace.

Hotel SB Icaria is located in the Olympic Port area, a 10-minute walk from Ciutadella Park and Barcelona Zoo. Ciutadella Metro Station is 800 metres away, and is just 2 stops from Barcelona Cathedral and the historic Gothic Quarter.

This modern hotel is situated on the northern edge of the city of Barcelona, near Avinguda Diagonal and Barcelona FC's famous stadium, Camp Nou. Guests have free access to the seasonal outdoor pool and the gym . Free WiFi is offered throughout the property.

The exterior facing rooms feature a flat-screen TV, minibar, and a safe. The bathroom comes with free toiletries, bath, and hairdryer.

Stroll around the gardens of the Abba Garden Hotel. There is also a paddle court, so you can play a quick game.

Grab a bite to eat in the snack bar in the evening - complete with terrace.

Zona Universitaria Metro Station that takes you to the Barcelona city centre is a 10-minute walk away. Metro Line 9 is a 13-minute walk away and it takes you to the airport within 15 minutes and to La Fira within 30 minutes.

Situated in the charming residential district of Sarrià, this elegant design hotel offers an outdoor pool and garden area, overlooking Tibidabo Mountain. Free Wi-Fi is available.

The Ikonik Anglí’s spacious rooms have a minimalist design and large windows, which provide plenty of natural light. Each air-conditioned room includes a flat-screen TV and a modern bathroom with a range of amenities.

Guests can enjoy a daily breakfast in the Angli’s stylish breakfast room. The Sarrià district is known for its wonderful cake shops, and there are also many popular bars within a 5-minute walk. The hotel also offers meeting rooms for events.

Sarrià FGC Train Station is 600 metres from the Ikonik Anglí, and offers direct services to Barcelona city centre. Plaza Catalunya Square is just a 10-minute train ride away. The nearest airport is Barcelona Airport, 15 minutes drive away from the hotel.

hotel_name: Stay U-nique Apartments Pau Claris II
description:
In the Eixample district of Barcelona, close to Passeig de Gracia, Stay U-nique Apartments Pau Claris II features free WiFi and a washing machine. It is located 800 metres from La Pedrera and provides a lift. The property is 400 metres from Casa Batllo, and within 600 metres of the city centre.

The air-conditioned apartment consists of 1 bedroom, a living room, a fully equipped kitchen with a dishwasher and a coffee machine, and 1 bathroom with a shower and a hair dryer. Towels and bed linen are provided in the apartment. The accommodation is non-smoking.

Popular points of interest near the apartment include Passeig de Gracia Metro Station, Tivoli Theatre and Palau de la Musica Catalana. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 13 km away.

Located within 1.4 km of Magic Fountain of Montjuic and less than 1 km of Sants Railway Station, Cozy Apartment in Sants provides rooms with air conditioning and a private bathroom in Barcelona. The property is around 3.2 km from Camp Nou, 3.5 km from Casa Batllo and 3.5 km from Palau Sant Jordi. When staying at the apartment, guests can use private entrance.

Each unit comes with a sofa, a seating area, a flat-screen TV, a well-fitted kitchen with a dining area, and a private bathroom with a hair dryer. Free WiFi is available to all guests, while some rooms are equipped with a balcony. At the apartment complex, each unit is equipped with bed linen and towels.

Passeig de Gracia Metro Station is 3.6 km from Cozy Apartment in Sants, while Plaça Catalunya is 3.9 km away. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 11 km from the property.

Free Wi-Fi and a TV are included in Hostalet de Barcelona’s bright, functional rooms. Hospital Clinic Metro Station is 300 metres away.

The Hostalet is a 15-minute walk from Passeig de Gràcia. This famous street is home to the Gaudi buildings, La Pedrera and Casa Batlló.

Hospital Clinic Metro Station offers direct trains to Sagrada Familia and Camp Nou Football Stadium. Provença Station is 800 metres away, and provides easy access to Plaza Catalunya Square.

Each simple, stylish room at the Hostalet has a private bathroom. Some rooms have a balcony, with views of the street or central patio. Guests receive a welcome gift of bottled water and a packet of biscuits.

Located in the lively Raval district and 250 metres from Las Ramblas, Hotel Casa Teva Barcelona has easy access to Barcelona’s Old Town. It features 24-hour reception and air-conditioned rooms with a TV.

Gaudi‘s Palau Güell is only 100 metres from the hotel, whilst La Boqueria Market is just a 5-minute walk away.

There are several restaurants, bars and cafés in the surrounding area. Barcelona’s Old Port and Maremagnum Shopping Centre are a 20-minute walk from the hotel.

Drassanes Metro Station is approximately 500 metres from the hotel.  Guests can reach sights such as the Sagrada Familia and Parc Güell in around 20 minutes, by Metro.

Ecozentric is located in central Barcelona, just 5 minutes’ walk from Plaza Catalunya and Gaudí’s Casa Batlló. This eco-friendly property offers modern rooms with free Wi-Fi and an LED TV.

The rooms at Ecozentric feature soundproofing and air conditioning. The TVs are low consumption, and the bed sheets are made of organic cotton. Each one has a private bathroom with a rain-effect shower.

The guest house offers free tea, coffee and biscuits throughout the day. There is a lounge where you can relax.

MACBA Modern Art Museum and the Raval district are a 7-minute walk from Ecozentric, and you can walk to the Boqueria Market and Palau de la Música Auditorium in 13 minutes. Airport buses leave from Plaza Catalunya.

Ecozentric donates part of every booking to the reforestation of woodland.

These modern apartments are in the Poblenou area of Barcelona, 500 metres from the beach. Free Wi-Fi is available in rooms and in public areas. The CCIB Convention Centre is within walking distance.

Poblenou Metro is 200 metres away and a 20-minute ride takes you to the city centre. There is easy access to the Gaudí buildings on Passeig de Gracia.

The apartments located in 2 separate buildings, 210 metres apart. All of them have a private kitchen complete with a washing machine, dishwasher, and oven. There is also a living room with a flat-screen TV.  Some apartments have a private terrace or balcony, and a communal terrace is available on the top floor.

Private parking is available at an extra cost. Non-smoking and family apartments are available.

The pictures at the top of this page are a selection of the different apartments located in the Poble Nou area in Barcelona. Please select a date and click on the apartments to see the pictures of the individual apartments.

Hostal Radio Barcelona is in central Barcelona, just 3 minutes’ walk from the MACBA and CCCB Modern Art Museums. It offers a 24-hour reception and rooms with a flat-screen TV. Free WiFi is provided.

The rooms at the Radio feature heating and each one has a private bathroom.

Guests at Hostal Radio Barcelona are welcome to enjoy a free walking tour service, available on request.

Hostal Radio Barcelona offers coffee, capuccino, chocolate and cold drinks for sale at their waiting room. There are numerous bars, restaurants and shops within 2 minutes’ walk and both Universitat square and Catalunya square are just 5 minutes away.

Airport buses leave from Plaza Catalunya and paid parking near the hotel is offered to our guests.

Feelathome Center Apartments offers a selection of quality apartments located in different areas of central Barcelona. Please check the room information to see the exact address of each apartment as well as pictures and descriptions

All  partments are located within 20 minutes’ walk of Plaza Catalunya, Barcelona’s main square. Most are in the stylish Eixample district.

Each apartment has a TV in the living room, and many also have a sofa bed. They have modern kitchens and bathrooms and most have parquet floors.

Every apartment is located close to a Metro Station which gives you access to the main tourist sights in under 15 minutes.

Ideally located just 100 metres off Barcelona’s central Plaça Catalunya and the exciting Las Ramblas, this new hotel blends a 19th-century façade with 21st-century decor and facilities.

The H10 Universitat lies in the cultural heart of this cosmopolitan city, allowing you to easily walk to many of the city’s unique sights. It is full of stylish, contemporary design and modern art. State-of-the-art amenities include free Wi-Fi available throughout the building.

Barceloneta Beach Apartments is set in the Ciutat Vella district of Barcelona, 400 metres from Sant Miquel Beach, 500 metres from Barceloneta Beach and 500 metres from Sant Sebastian Beach. The property is close to Plaça Reial, Palau de la Musica Catalana and Cathedral of Barcelona. Passeig de Gracia is 3.5 km from the apartment and Plaça Catalunya is 4.2 km away.

All of the air-conditioned units feature a private bathroom, flat-screen TV, fully equipped kitchenette and balcony.

Popular points of interest near the apartment include Santa Maria del Mar, Picasso Museum and Port Olimpic. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 13 km from the property.

Featuring a roof terrace and free Wi-Fi, Flor Parks is set on Barcelona’s Las Ramblas, beside Liceu Metro Station. Located 200 metres from La Boqueria Market, it offers soundproofed rooms.

The Flor Parks' air-conditioned rooms have a balcony, satellite TV and a minibar. Their private bathrooms have hairdryers and some have hydromassage baths.

Set menu and à la carte dishes are served at the Hotel Flor’s restaurant. There is also a snack bar and café.

The hotel’s central location makes it perfect for exploring the city’s Gothic Quarter and Barcelona Cathedral is just 10 minutes’ walk away. The Port and Maremagnum Shopping Centre are less than 1 km from the Flor Parks.

Situated in the L'Eixample neighbourhood of Barcelona, Hostal Aslyp 114 offers free WiFi and features a shared lounge with flat-screen TV and satellite channels. Plaza Catalunya is 2.8 km away.

Fitted with tile flooring, the guest house has air-conditioning and heating. The rooms feature simple décor, wardrobe and city view. The private bathroom has a shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer.

The property offers a continental breakfast and vending machines are available.

Restaurants, shops and bars are within 250 metres away. Gaudí's famous Sagrada Familia Cathedral is 3.5 km from Hostal Aslyp 114. Sants Metro and Train Station is a 15-minute walk away.

Barcelona Airport is 20 minute-drive away. Hostal Aslyp 114 offers shuttle service for a surcharge.

Chic & Basic Zoo is located in El Born, now one of the most fashionable and cosmopolitan districts of central Barcelona. On one side is the Gothic Quarter, to the other is Ciutadella Park, and the port is a few minutes away.

From the hotel, you can easily get to the historic city centre, the Gothic Quarter (Barrio Gótico) where the Cathedral, Santa Maria del Mar, Plaza Sant Jaume and Santa Anna are located.

The hotel is also very close to the zoo, the Ciutadella Park, beaches and the Olympic Port. In the neighborhood you will also find nightlife, bars, restaurants (the area of El Born is where you´ll find the most typical ‘tapas’) and museums, such as the Picasso Museum.

In the Eixample district of Barcelona, close to Passeig de Gracia, Bed&BCN Diagonal 1 features free WiFi and a washing machine. With city views, this accommodation provides a balcony. The property is 300 metres from La Pedrera, and within 1.4 km of the city centre.

This air-conditioned apartment comes with 2 bedrooms, a flat-screen TV, a dining area, a fully equipped kitchen with a dishwasher, and a living room. Towels and bed linen are featured in the apartment. The accommodation is non-smoking.

Popular points of interest near the apartment include Casa Batllo, Passeig de Gracia Metro Station and Tivoli Theatre. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat, 14 km from Bed&BCN Diagonal 1, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

Located 150 metres from Barceloneta Beach in Barcelona, City&Beach Apartments features free WiFi and air conditioning.

The modern, two-bedroom apartments include a kitchen is equipped with a microwave and a washing machine. Towels and bed linen are included.

You will find many restaurants, bars and supermarkets in the area.

Port Vell can be reached in 5 minutes' walk, and Barceloneta Metro Station is a 10-minute walk away.

Located next to the Fira de Barcelona Exhibition Centre, these bright modern apartments offer free WiFi and a flat-screen TV. Plaza Espanya Square is just 50 metres away.

Each stylish Ding Dong Fira Apartment is decorated in light colours, with smart wooden floors. Apartments have a lounge with a sofa bed, and air conditioning and heating is available in the lounge only.

There is a well-equipped open-plan kitchenette with a washing machine, microwave, toaster, Nespresso coffee machine and utensils. Towels and bed linen are provided and there is a hairdryer.

A range of bars, restaurants and shops can be found within a 5-minute walk of the Fira Apartments by Gaiarooms. The famous Magic Fountain and Las Arenas Shopping Centre are both within 100 metres.

Espanya Metro Station, 250 metres away, offers direct metro services within 10 minutes to Plaza Catalunya and Las Ramblas. Sants International Train Station is within a 500 metre walk of the apartments or can be reached by direct metro line. Buses to and from the airport, as well as city tour buses, stop 3 minutes' walk from the apartments.

AB Poble Sec Apartment has a terrace and is situated in Barcelona, within just 1.7 km of Boqueria Market and 1.4 km of Palau Sant Jordi. The property is set 2.5 km from Plaça Catalunya, 2.5 km from Portal de l'Angel and 2.7 km from Passeig de Gracia. Free WiFi is available throughout the property and Magic Fountain of Montjuic is less than 1 km away.

The 2-bedroom apartment features a living room with a TV, a fully equipped kitchen with a microwave and a toaster, and 2 bathrooms with a hair dryer. Towels and bed linen are available in the apartment.

Sants Railway Station is 2.9 km from the apartment, while Cathedral of Barcelona is 3.3 km from the property. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 12 km away.

Set 100 metres from Barcelona’s Nova Mar Bella Beach, Front Maritim offers free WiFi and a gym with sauna. The Fòrum and CCIB Convention Centre are within a 15-minute walk.

All rooms at Hotel Front Maritim are modern and functional. There is a flat-screen TV and a work desk, and the private bathroom comes with a shower and free toiletries.

The Front Maritim’s restaurant serves a wide range of modern Mediterranean cuisine.

Hotel Front Maritim is 700 metres from the shops and restaurants of Diagonal Mar Shopping Centre. Selva de Mar Metro Station is within a 10-minute walk, and nearby bus stops offer regular links to Barcelona City Centre.

Other services that can be requested and are subject to availability included early check-in, late check-out, breakfast bag (for early check out). and cribs. These services may have an additional cost.

In the Ciutat Vella district of Barcelona, close to Cathedral of Barcelona, Stay U-nique Apartment Boters features free WiFi and a washing machine. Guests staying at this apartment have access to a balcony. The property is 400 metres from the city centre and 2.1 km from Sant Miquel Beach.

The air-conditioned apartment consists of 1 bedroom, a living room, a fully equipped kitchen with a dishwasher and a coffee machine, and 1 bathroom with a bath and a hair dryer. Towels and bed linen are provided in the apartment. The accommodation is non-smoking.

Popular points of interest near the apartment include Santa Maria del Mar, Plaça Reial and Picasso Museum. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 13 km from Stay U-nique Apartment Boters.

Hostal Lausanne is on Barcelona’s popular shopping street, Portal de l’Angel. It is a 2-minute walk from the Rambla and Plaza Catalunya Metro Station, and offers a free Wi-Fi zone.

Rooms at the Hostal Lausanne are simple and functional. There is a choice between rooms with a private or shared bathroom, and some have a sink.

The sightseeing bus stops in nearby Plaza Catalunya. The Gothic Quarter and Paseo de Gracia Avenue are within a 5-minute walk.

Bicycle and car rental are available, and the Lausanne has a 24-hour front desk.

Set in the Gothic Quarter and next to Urquinaona Metro Station, HCC Montblanc offers  air-conditioned rooms, free Wi-Fi, satellite TV and a minibar.

Guests can enjoy a varied buffet breakfast and à la carte Mediterranean cuisine in El Racó del Montblanc restaurant.

Close to the Born district, Hotel Montblanc Barcelona is a 10-minute walk from Barcelona Cathedral and 500 metres from Plaza de Catalunya. Palau de la Musica Concert Hall, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is just 250 metres away.

City tour buses and direct buses to Barcelona Airport stop at Plaza Catalunya.

Offering free Wi-Fi, MH Apartments Gracia offers  bright, soundproofed apartments located in Barcelona’s Gracia District, 10 minutes’ walk from Passeig de Gracia.

Featuring wooden floors, each soundproofed apartment has a living room with a sofa and satellite flat-screen TV. A dishwasher, oven and washing machine are included in the kitchen. Some apartments come with 2 bathrooms.

Private parking and an airport shuttle service are available at an extra cost and there is luggage storage.

A large variety of bars and restaurants can be found in the area, There is a 24-hour supermarket 500 meters from the apartments.

Gaudí’s Sagrada Familia and La Pedrera can be visited within a 20-minute walk. Fontana Metro Station, with connection to Plaça Catalunya and Barcelona’s historic centre, is 400 metres away.

Situated in Barcelona, 2.3 km from Nova Icaria Beach and 2.6 km from Somorrostro Beach, Barnapartments Monumental features air-conditioned accommodation with a balcony and free WiFi. It is set 700 metres from Sagrada Familia and provides a lift. The property is non-smoking and is located 2.7 km from Bogatell Beach.

This apartment features 1 bedroom, a kitchen with a microwave and a toaster, a flat-screen TV, a seating area and 1 bathroom. Towels and bed linen are available in the apartment. For added privacy, the accommodation features a private entrance.

Sightseeing tours are available in the surrounding area.

Popular points of interest near the apartment include Casa Batllo, La Pedrera and Passeig de Gracia. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 15 km from the property, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

hotel_name: Hotel Midmost by Majestic Hotel Group
description:
Located in the heart of Barcelona, Hotel Midmost by Majestic Hotel Group is a few steps from the famous Ramblas and the Gothic Quarter. This stylish hotel features a roof terrace with a pool (not climatized) and views over the city.

The Hotel Midmost by Majestic Hotel Group has elegant interiors with all modern comforts. Relax in a sunny en suite bedroom, decorated in soothing soft colours and with air conditioning, free WiFi, satellite TV and a Nespresso coffee machine.

Treat yourself to a delicious meal in the hotel’s restaurant, or step outside to sample the huge range of regional and international foods in one of Barcelona’s many restaurants.

Take a stroll up the impressive Passeig de Gracia to visit the famous Modernista creations of Gaudi, or visit the colourful Ramblas and the mouthwatering food stalls of the Boqueria market.

Villa Sagrada offers self-catering accommodation with free WiFi, air conditioning and a balcony with street views, just 550 metres from Sagrada Familia. Encants Metro Station is 3 minutes’ walk away.

This modern studio has a 2 single beds, a sofa bed, a flat-screen TV and dining table. The kitchenette is equipped with a fridge, hob, microwave and coffee machine. There is also a bathroom with a shower.

You will find bars, restaurants and supermarkets in the surrounding streets.

Plaza Catalunya, with direct buses to Barcelona Airport is a 15-minute metro ride away and Barceloneta Beach is 3.5 km away.

These apartments are located 5 minutes' walk from Plaza Catalunya. DestinationBCN Apartment Suites in Barcelona offers air-conditioned apartments featuring designer furniture and fully-equipped kitchens.

Each apartment has its own individual identity and striking original feature in combination with a stylish décor. Some have bay windows and private furnished terraces. All of the apartments feature free Wi-Fi and Swiss-made mattress.

Their kitchens include an oven and dishwasher, and are stocked with herbs, spices and coffee. In the lounge there are sofas, flat-screen satellite TV  Some of the bathrooms feature rain showers or bath tubs.

Their location in the centre of Barcelona makes reaching all corners of the city very easy. The nearby Gothic and Raval districts are full of shops, restaurants and bars of all types.

Situated in Barcelona, 1.8 km from Bogatell Beach, Hotel SB Glow 4 Sup features accommodation with a seasonal outdoor swimming pool, private parking, a fitness centre and a shared lounge. Featuring a terrace, the 4-star hotel has air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi, each with a private bathroom. Guests can use the sauna and the hammam, or enjoy city views.

All units at the hotel are fitted with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels and a safety deposit box. The rooms will provide guests with a desk and a coffee machine.

Guests at Hotel SB Glow 4 Sup can enjoy a buffet breakfast. At the accommodation you will find a restaurant serving Mediterranean and Grill BBQ cuisine. Vegetarian, dairy-free and vegan options can also be requested.

The area is popular for cycling, and bike hire is available at Hotel SB Glow 4 Sup.

Speaking Catalan, English, Spanish and French at the reception, staff will be happy to provide guests with practical advice on the area.

Nova Icaria Beach is 1.8 km from the hotel, while Mar Bella Beach is 2.1 km from the property. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 15 km away.

Surrounded by the fascinating streets of the Gothic Quarter, this elegant hotel is located right at Barcelona’s historic heart – just a short walk from the cathedral and Las Ramblas.

The Gran Hotel Barcino is set in a street which runs off the magnificent square of Sant Jaume, home to both the Catalonian government and the city council. The narrow streets which surround the hotel are full of fashionable shops, historic sites and museums, such as the Picasso Museum.

See the city’s many sights then return for a good night’s sleep in your traditional-style room. The rooms feature marble floors and air conditioning.

Within walking distance from Las Ramblas, Plaza de Catalunya and Passeig de Gràcia, Cien is set in a 19th-century building. It offers air-conditioned rooms and free Wi-Fi.

Cien's 8 rooms feature warm, minimalist décor, heating, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with shower.

There is a terrace where guests can have breakfast. Coffee and snacks are provided in the lounge area throughout the day.

The property is less than 5 minutes’ walk from Universitat, Catalunya or Passeig de Gràcia Metro stations. Centrally located, Cien is close to Barcelona’s main shopping area. Numerous bars and restaurants serving national and international food can be found nearby.

You can catch buses to Barcelona Airport from Plaza Catalunya, while trains to the airport and coastal town of Sitges leave from Passeig de Gracia Train Station, 250 metres away.

BacHome Barcelona B&B offers free Wi-Fi and features elegant rooms with street views. Paseo de Gracia, with its high end shops, restaurants and Gaudi's La Pedrera and Casa Batló, is just 200 metres from this bed and breakfast.

Featuring plenty of natural light and stylish décor, each air-conditioned bedroom comes with a seating area, flat-screen TV and a wardrobe. Fitted with parquet flooring, the spacious bedrooms also have heating. The modern bathrooms have a shower and they include a hairdryer and free toiletries.

BacHome Barcelona B&B has 24 hour coffee machine.
